programme.desc: S16 E11 — Agente Provocador Madison Baker foge de casa para comparecer à festa de uma estrela de cinema. Tudo se complica quando a garota é encontrada num beco e com indícios de estupro.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S16 E12 — Pai Encantador Nicolas, pai de Amaro, vai casar e o filho é convidado para o evento. Entretanto, uma confusão se instaura na ocasião e Nicolas acaba algemado. Com isso, Amaro se torna testemunha de um caso que pode expor os segredos da família.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S16 E13 — Moral Decadente Uma menina é encontrada chorando e com roupas rasgadas na rua. Os indícios apontam que ela foi estuprada por Jerome Jones no banheiro de uma pizzaria. Revoltado, o pai da adolescente decide fazer justiça.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S16 E14 — Jogo de Intimidação Raina Punjabi cria seu primeiro jogo de videogame e é insultada e ameaçada de morte por um grupo de homens de uma comunidade virtual sobre o tema. Enquanto isso, uma funcionária é atacada numa convenção.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S16 E15 — Mãe Infiltrada Carisi se disfarça para investigar um caso envolvendo tráfico sexual e conhece Martha, uma mulher que se infiltrou na organização há três anos em busca de sua filha Ariel.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S15 E20 — Obsessão Animal O algoz de Benson, Willian Lewis, escapa da prisão. Apesar de um forte esquema de segurança, ele consegue sequestrá-la. Benson precisa decidir o que irá sacrificar para salvar a vida de uma criança.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S15 E21 — Blues Pós-Morte A Corregedoria começa a investigar as ações de Benson no cativeiro que culminaram na morte de Willian Lewis e decreta sua prisão. Pressionada, a detetive precisará escolher entre suas convicções e a carreira.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S15 E22 — Dúvida Razoável O produtor Frank Maddox é acusado de molestar a filha de 8 anos. Sua esposa, uma atriz famosa, quer justiça para a menina, porém ela se recusa a cooperar, o que leva os detetives a suspeitarem de suas acusações.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S15 E23 — Criminoso De Pensamento Os detetives realizam uma operação para prender um famoso fotógrafo, que tem uma vida secreta. A investigação revela que suas fantasias podem ter vitimado crianças, porém nenhuma evidência é encontrada.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S15 E24 — Despertar da Primavera O temperamento de Nick o coloca como alvo da Corregedoria e ele precisa enfrentar as consequências. Enquanto isso, uma investigação de roubo e estupro revela que um dos suspeitos possui ligação com Benson.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S16 E1 — Meninas Desaparecidas Benson quer justiça no caso da prostituta queimada e, para tal, precisa da ajuda de Amaro. Entretanto, suas ações podem colocar pessoas em perigo, especialmente a filha da vítima, agora sob sua tutela.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S16 E2 — Desgraça Americana O jogador de basquete Shakir The Shark Wilkins anuncia uma parceria com a famosa grife Orion. Entretanto, o atleta é acusado de estupro pela porta-voz da marca e logo se inicia uma investigação para analisar a veracidade da história.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S16 E3 — Percentual do Produtor A estrela de Hollywood Tensley Evans tenta se safar do acidente de carro que cometeu. O modo como Amaro lida com a situação o põe de volta à equipe a tempo de investigar outra acusação contra Evans, desta vez de estupro.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S16 E4 — Manifesto Do Holden Um homem cria uma espécie de diário em vídeo para relatar seus problemas com mulheres. Entretanto, os detetives descobrem as filmagens antes dele cometer mais um ato violento. Enquanto isso, Benson tenta lidar com a maternidade e a carreira.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S16 E5 — Réquiem para uma Estrela Pornô Barnes crê ter conseguido um trabalho como modelo, mas descobre se tratar de pornografia pela internet. Enquanto isso, Evie é forçada a provar sua inocência diante do tribunal.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: Guilherme é contador e mantém uma vida pacata, mas acaba descobrindo que há um grande desfalque orçamentário na empresa em que trabalha. Um dia, ele se envolve emocionalmente com uma antiga namorada de colégio, Lara. Na tentativa de se livrar de uma dívida e de Zulu, seu problemático namorado, ela atrai Guilherme para um esquema de corrução responsável por abastecer as falcatruas de políticos brasileiros.
programme.title: Reação em Cadeia

programme.desc: Sara, Lia e Leia são melhores amigas e seus sonhos são interrompidos quando é decretada a pandemia.
programme.title: Licença para Enlouquecer

programme.desc: S3 E8 — Laura Laura pega Covid-19 e precisa ser internada. Paulo precisa alternar entre seus atendimentos e cuidar de Laura, cujo caso se agrava. Finalmente a vacina chega.
programme.title: Unidade Básica

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Culpado até que se Prove o Contrário Uma dançarina é acusada de roubo, mesmo estando em outra cidade na hora do crime; cobrador de ônibus é baleado e preso em frente a um supermercado assaltado; um homem inocente, que ajudava jovens a saírem do crime, é preso injustamente por tráfico.
programme.title: Sede de Justiça

programme.desc: S4 E6 — Além do Mar Vários corpos são encontrados em uma cidade litorânea e Stabler precisa lidar com as questões políticas e os segredos de uma comunidade muito unida para encontrar um possível serial killer. Jet coloca uma testemunha sob sua proteção.
programme.title: Law & Order: Organized Crime

programme.desc: S16 E19 — Concedendo Imunidade Fotos pornográficas de uma menina de 15 anos espalham-se pela escola da vítima e Barba precisa descobrir o culpado pelo crime. Enquanto isso, Amaro recebe notícias ruins envolvendo seu filho.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S16 E20 — Sonhador Acordado O Chicago PD se une à SVU em Nova York, e Benson e Voight lideram uma investigação de um estupro que é muito semelhante a um caso de uma década atrás.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S16 E21 — Justiça Pervertida Bayard Ellis assume o caso de um homem preso por incesto e estupro, cuja filha era a vítima. Ela quer retirar seu depoimento e liberar seu pai da prisão.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S16 E22 — O Pesadelo dos Pais Após um menino de 8 anos desaparecer da escola, o detetive Amaro se junta aos pais divorciados da criança para achar o suspeito. Tensões causadas pelo ex-casal atrapalham a investigação.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S16 E23 — Entregando Noah Benson e Barba levam Johnny D. a julgamento por tráfico sexual, estupro e sequestro. Enquanto isso, o futuro da equipe está em jogo quando eles enfrentam uma ameaça em um intenso confronto na corte.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S17 E1 — Dissecação Diabólica A detetive Rollins espera extrair uma confissão do assassino em série Gregory Yates quando um corpo aparece na praia onde ele enterrava vítimas. Mas as informações de Yates fazem ondas de choque se espalharem pelo departamento de polícia.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S17 E2 — Patologia Criminosa A detetive Rollins espera extrair uma confissão do assassino em série Gregory Yates quando um corpo aparece na praia onde ele enterrava vítimas. Mas as informações de Yates fazem ondas de choque se espalharem pelo departamento de polícia.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S1 E5 — Maligno Os doutores Rhodes e Zanetti tentam salvar um membro do quartel de Chicago Fire; uma mulher resgatada de um prédio em chamas leva todos a um mistério maior.
programme.title: Chicago Med

programme.desc: S1 E6 — Fronteira O Departamento de Segurança Interna questiona Sharon sobre dois aviões com passageiros clandestinos levados ao hospital; Rhodes recebe uma homenagem após fazer uma grande doação ao hospital.
programme.title: Chicago Med

programme.title: Blue Bloods

Agora, com o mundo em risco, Ethan e sua equipe da IMF são forçados a aliar-se a um obstinado agente da CIA.

programme.desc: Após um verão desastroso, Harry volta para o seu quinto ano em Hogwarts, um dos mais difíceis que terá de encarar. Pouquíssimos alunos e pais acreditam nele ou em Dumbledore sobre a volta de Voldemort, e uma série interminável de artigos circula dizendo que eles estão completamente malucos. Ainda por cima, Dolores Umbridge, a nova professora de Defesa Contra as Artes das Trevas, prova ser a pessoa mais repugnante que Harry já conheceu.
programme.title: Harry Potter e a Ordem da Fênix

programme.desc: No sexto ano de Harry em Hogwarts, Lord Voldemort e seus Comensais da Morte estão criando o terror nos mundos bruxo e trouxa. Dumbledore convence seu velho amigo Horácio Slughorn para retornar a Hogwarts como professor de poções após Harry encontrar um estranho livro escolar. Draco Malfoy se esforça para realizar uma ação destinada por Voldemort, enquanto Dumbledore e Harry trabalham secretamente juntos a fim de descobrir o método para destruir o Lorde das Trevas uma vez por todas.
programme.title: Harry Potter e o Enigma do Príncipe

programme.desc: Sem a proteção de seus professores, Harry, Rony e Hermione começam uma missão para destruir as Horcruxes, que são fontes da imortalidade de Voldemort. Mais do que nunca, eles dependem uns dos outros, mas forças obscuras ameaçam separá-los.
programme.title: Harry Potter e as Relíquias da Morte - Parte 1

programme.desc: A batalha entre as forças do bem e do mal da magia alcançam o mundo dos trouxas. O risco nunca foi tão grande, e ninguém está seguro. Harry Potter precisa fazer um sacrifício final conforme o confronto com Lord Voldemort se aproxima.

programme.desc: Após um verão desastroso, Harry volta para o seu quinto ano em Hogwarts, um dos mais difíceis que terá de encarar. Pouquíssimos alunos e pais acreditam nele ou em Dumbledore sobre a volta de Voldemort, e uma série interminável de artigos circula dizendo que eles estão completamente malucos. Ainda por cima, Dolores Umbridge, a nova professora de Defesa Contra as Artes das Trevas, prova ser a pessoa mais repugnante que Harry já conheceu.
programme.title: Harry Potter e a Ordem da Fênix

programme.desc: No sexto ano de Harry em Hogwarts, Lord Voldemort e seus Comensais da Morte estão criando o terror nos mundos bruxo e trouxa. Dumbledore convence seu velho amigo Horácio Slughorn para retornar a Hogwarts como professor de poções após Harry encontrar um estranho livro escolar. Draco Malfoy se esforça para realizar uma ação destinada por Voldemort, enquanto Dumbledore e Harry trabalham secretamente juntos a fim de descobrir o método para destruir o Lorde das Trevas uma vez por todas.
programme.title: Harry Potter e o Enigma do Príncipe

programme.desc: Sem a proteção de seus professores, Harry, Rony e Hermione começam uma missão para destruir as Horcruxes, que são fontes da imortalidade de Voldemort. Mais do que nunca, eles dependem uns dos outros, mas forças obscuras ameaçam separá-los.
programme.title: Harry Potter e as Relíquias da Morte - Parte 1

programme.desc: A batalha entre as forças do bem e do mal da magia alcançam o mundo dos trouxas. O risco nunca foi tão grande, e ninguém está seguro. Harry Potter precisa fazer um sacrifício final conforme o confronto com Lord Voldemort se aproxima.

programme.desc: No ensino médio, Mike foi uma estrela do basquete e tinha um futuro promissor, mas jogou tudo para o alto ao casar-se com sua namorada, que estava grávida. Quase 20 anos depois, com o casamento arruinado e um trabalho que não o leva para lugar algum, seus filhos o consideram um fracassado. Milagrosamente, ele volta a ser um adolescente de 17 anos e tem a chance de corrigir os erros que cometeu no passado.
programme.title: 17 Outra Vez

programme.desc: Jenna Rink é uma garota que está descontente com sua própria idade. Em seu 13º aniversário, ela faz um pedido: virar adulta. O pedido milagrosamente se torna realidade e, no dia seguinte, Jenna acorda com 30 anos.
programme.title: De Repente 30

programme.desc: Após anos de encontros desastrosos procurando pelo par ideal, Charlotte se apaixona pelo homem perfeito, Kevin. O problema é a mãe dele, que, depois de ser demitida do cargo de âncora de um jornal de rede nacional, decide se dedicar à tarefa de atrapalhar o casal com medo de perder mais uma coisa importante de sua vida.
programme.title: A Sogra

programme.desc: Henry Roth é um veterinário paquerador que vive no Havaí e famoso pelo grande número de turistas que conquista. Seu novo alvo é Lucy Whitmore, que mora no local e por quem Henry se apaixona perdidamente. No entanto, Lucy sofre de falta de memória de curto prazo e se esquece rapidamente de fatos que acabaram de acontecer. Assim, Henry é obrigado a conquistá-la, dia após dia, para ficar ao seu lado.
programme.title: Como se Fosse a Primeira Vez

programme.desc: Após um primeiro encontro desastroso, Jim e Lauren viajam, por coincidência, para o mesmo hotel durante as férias, com seus filhos de casamentos anteriores. Eles são obrigados a conviver e uma atração começa a surgir entre os dois.

programme.desc: Newsmagazine O programa é formatado para ser uma revista eletrônica de informação e entretenimento para os telespectadores aos domingos. Seu principal diferencial é oferecer uma opção inteligente no horário dos tradicionais programas de auditório.Uma conceituada equipe de profissionais trabalha durante toda a semana para apresentar, no domingo, um jornalismo ágil e moderno, com reportagens de denúncia, comportamento, ciência, turismo, medicina e aventura, além de um panorama geral dos fatos que marcaram a semana. O esporte também tem o seu espaço garantido e é pauta constante das matérias do programa. Os repórteres viajam pelo país e também para o exterior em busca da informação que interessa aos brasileiros nos quatro cantos do país. Nos bastidores, soma-se a eles uma excelente equipe com cerca de 50 profissionais entre editores, produtores e cinegrafistas.

programme.desc: S10 E12 — O Psicopata Sexual Especialistas estudam um subgrupo de psicopatas motivados por seus desejos e fantasias sexuais exacerbados; esse subgrupo de criminosos não apenas pratica violência física, mas também violência sexual contra suas vítimas.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Onde Nasce o Mal Um simpático rapaz de 20 anos quer ajudar com uma investigação de assassinato. Ele diz ter apenas conhecido uma das três vítimas, mas os detetives suspeitam que ele possa estar escondendo um lado macabro.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S4 E3 — Neve Escarlate No norte da Califórnia, a polícia encontra um funcionário do Serviço Florestal dos Estados Unidos executado sob um monte de neve. Uma carteira perdida coloca o investigador de Greg Hagwood no encalço de um psicopata assassino.
programme.title: Detetive Americano com Joe Kenda

programme.desc: Special A Dra. Ramsland entrevista Elmer Wayne Henley e analisa sua trajetória nos assassinatos em massa de Houston, em 1973.
programme.title: O Aprendiz de Serial Killer

programme.desc: S1 E3 — O Mundo Ficará Sabendo Wuornos arrisca a vida ao contar ao júri sua história com suas próprias palavras.
programme.title: Desmascarando um Monstro - Aileen Wuornos

programme.desc: S1 E1 — As Duas Caras de Stephen Collins Durante dez anos, Stephen Collins representou um pai e pastor de comportamento irrepreensível no programa "7th Heaven". Em outubro de 2014, seu mundo desmorona quando ele admite abusar de garotas menores de idade.
programme.title: O Lado Sombrio de Hollywood

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Órfã ou Impostora? Michael Barnett revela que Natalia tentou envenená-los e causar danos, à medida que as próprias mentiras dos Barnetts vêm à tona.
programme.title: O Curioso Caso de Natalia Grace

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Black Bart e a Coelhinha O marido de uma ex-coelhinha da Playboy é morto em casa e a investigação revela casos sórdidos, brigas familiares e um possível assassino de aluguel. A busca pela verdade leva a vários suspeitos.
programme.title: Playboy - Fama e Morte

programme.desc: S1 E5 — A Garota com a Tatuagem de Estrela Star Stowe se torna a Playmate do Mês e conquista o mundo. Mas tudo o que a revista tem a oferecer leva Star a um mundo de abuso e vício - interrompendo seus sonhos, deixando-a sozinha em um caminho trágico.
programme.title: Playboy - Fama e Morte

programme.desc: S1 E6 — Sugar Baby Uma modelo da Playboy Itália de 25 anos se envolve com um médico de 71 anos. Ele a sustenta por dois anos e lhe dá mais de 300.000 dólares antes de ameaçar largá-la para sempre, e o relacionamento deles toma um rumo mortal.
programme.title: Playboy - Fama e Morte

programme.desc: S9 E6 — Procurando por Angela Em Prairie Village, Kansas, uma mãe reclusa desaparece em 2019. Sua filha adolescente e a polícia buscam respostas, mas são vítimas de manipulação psicológica a cada passo. Sem rastros digitais ou mesmo um amigo que a conheça, as pistas estão se esgotando rapidamente.
programme.title: People Magazine - Além da Notícia

programme.desc: S9 E7 — A Garota da Bicicleta Em 1972, Jody Loomis, de 20 anos, sai para um passeio de bicicleta no final da tarde para visitar seu cavalo e nunca mais volta para casa. Ela é encontrada assassinada na floresta, e seu caso intriga as autoridades locais.
programme.title: People Magazine - Além da Notícia

programme.desc: S9 E4 — Brincando com Fogo Um homem é espancado até a morte e sua casa é incendiada. Enquanto a polícia procura os filhos desaparecidos, um amigo da família muda tudo.
programme.title: People Magazine - Além da Notícia

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Temporada 1 Episódio 1 Uma explosão perturba a tranquilidade de La Mora, uma comunidade de mórmons norte-americanos em Sonora, no norte do México. Os corpos de uma mulher e de seus filhos são encontrados carbonizados, e outra família desaparece.
programme.title: Massacre dos Mórmons

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Temporada 1 Episódio 2 Um dos menores desaparecidos consegue chegar a La Mora e revela que outras duas mães e mais duas crianças foram assassinadas. A comunidade se organiza e sai em busca das crianças.
programme.title: Massacre dos Mórmons

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Temporada 1 Episódio 3 As crianças sobreviventes são levadas para um hospital no Arizona; a família tenta descobrir quem está por trás do massacre; as autoridades dos Estados Unidos pedem respostas e os investigadores mexicanos procuram provas.
programme.title: Massacre dos Mórmons

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Temporada 1 Episódio 4 As autoridades mexicanas prendem suspeitos do massacre, em meio à desconfiança dos familiares das vítimas; o depoimento exclusivo de um integrante de La Línea confirma suas suspeitas sobre os motivos do ataque.
programme.title: Massacre dos Mórmons

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Triângulo de Sangue Policiais que fazem a ronda em Myrtle Beach encontram um carro abandonado ao lado de um ancoradouro. Os investigadores logo descobrem que a dona do carro, Heather Elvis, desapareceu após se envolver com um homem casado.
programme.title: Mistério ID - O Caso Heather Elvis

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Impasse no Tribunal Dois anos e meio depois do desaparecimento de Heather Elvis, seus sequestradores são julgados. Reviravoltas nos casos de Sidney Moorer e sua esposa, Tammy, levam a família de Heather a perder a fé na justiça.
programme.title: Mistério ID - O Caso Heather Elvis

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Mistérios em Baja O sonho de um homem rico de ter um paraíso à beira-mar no México se transforma em pesadelo após a polícia o encontrar brutalmente assassinado. Um triângulo amoroso, enganos e traição se desenrolam em um caso onde a ganância colide com ambição mortal.
programme.title: Férias Mortais

programme.desc: S2 E3 — Poderia Ser Você Amanhã Matima, estrela de dança do TikTok, e o estilista Quinton fazem sucesso nas redes. Mas eles não sabem que alguém os observa com inveja.
programme.title: Influência Mortal - Assassinatos nas Redes Sociais

programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S1 E19 — Homens Surtados Um jovem precisa se defender e proteger a noiva de um invasor com uma metralhadora; um homem comete um ataque violento em um restaurante e duas mulheres têm de lutar para sobreviver.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S1 E20 — Terror Embriagado Dois policiais tentam parar um motorista bêbado que acelera na contramão e se veem em uma situação perigosa; uma família percebe um carro ziguezagueando assustadoramente e age para prevenir uma tragédia.
programme.title: Crimes que Viralizaram

programme.desc: S1 E3 — O Mundo Ficará Sabendo Wuornos arrisca a vida ao contar ao júri sua história com suas próprias palavras.
programme.title: Desmascarando um Monstro - Aileen Wuornos

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Eu Sou uma Boa Garota Em colaboração com a ex-namorada dela, os detetives armam uma emboscada para Wuornos, que entra voluntariamente na sala de interrogatório e choca a todos. Entrevistas exclusivas com amigos de Wuornos revelam como ela se tornou a assassina que todos conhecem.
programme.title: Desmascarando um Monstro - Aileen Wuornos

programme.desc: S1 E5 — A Maldição da Garra de Ferro Seis irmãos formam uma dinastia de lutadores, mas cinco morrem ainda jovens. O único sobrevivente conta como a fama, os vícios e personagens excêntricos se tornam a maldição do negócio familiar.
programme.title: O Lado Sombrio de Hollywood

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Agonia Gelada Surgem novos detalhes sobre a descuidada coleta de provas, além de testemunhos conflitantes, imagens de vídeo manipuladas e estranhos exames de DNA. A equipe de Karen Read sugere que há uma conspiração em curso.
programme.title: Mistério na Neve - O Caso Karen Read

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Lobo em Pele de Cordeiro Uma olhada nas acusações relativas ao "showrunner" Dan Schneider, incluindo um local de trabalho tóxico para escritoras e a prisão de dois membros da equipe por abuso infantil.
programme.title: O Lado Sombrio da TV Infantil

programme.desc: S6 E3 — O Observador Em um raro dia de folga, a mãe solo Carrie Caudill sai para se divertir com uma amiga. Um confronto inesperado deixa Carrie em rota de colisão com um homem louco, sádico e calculista.
programme.title: Seu Pior Pesadelo

programme.desc: S2 E1 — Monstro Disfarçado Os assassinatos brutais de uma mulher e seus três filhos pequenos em sua residência abala a comunidade de Tallahassee, no estado da Flórida. A busca pelo assassino expõe um monstro que conhecia a família.
programme.title: Mentiras Criminosas

programme.desc: S4 E4 — O Fantasma da Rodovia No início dos anos 1970, Washington DC é aterrorizada por um assassino que sequestra e mata seis jovens afro-americanas.
programme.title: People Magazine - Além da Notícia

programme.desc: S1 E6 — Senhor Intocável Um assassinato a sangue-frio tira a vida do jogador e herói local TK Kelly. O destaque do time de futebol americano carregava os sonhos da cidade pequena nas costas, mas a inveja teria despertado motivação para o crime.
programme.title: Assassinato de uma Sexta à Noite

programme.desc: S4 E3 — As Aparências Enganam Uma mulher supostamente mata seu filho pequeno e se suicida. Quando três jovens enfermeiras são assassinadas em sequência, a polícia teme a ação de um serial killer.
programme.title: Ainda um Mistério

programme.desc: S5 E6 — A Mudança Kiana Marshall, seu irmão Corey e seu amigo Alexis são assassinados. Versões discrepantes levam os detetives a uma caçada infrutífera, mas os assassinos são revelados e devem enfrentar as consequências.
programme.title: Câmera Crime

programme.desc: S6 E10 — Mulheres Mortais Assassinatos cometidos por mulheres costumam chocar, mas as psicopatas não são tão raras como as pessoas imaginam. Especialistas analisam características peculiares dessas homicidas e exploram seus crimes horríveis.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S4 E9 — Lista de Mulheres Um homem desequilibrado ataca três mulheres e as mata em suas casas. Começa, então, uma caça ao homem em todo o estado, que enfurece um psicopata misógino decidido a se vingar.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.desc: S4 E5 — A Tatuagem de Rosa O corpo de um homem da Carolina do Sul aparece boiando em um rio local. Em seu primeiro caso de homicídio, Allen Morris investiga a esposa e a amante da vítima para desvendar uma trama repleta de reviravoltas.
programme.title: Detetive Americano com Joe Kenda

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Mistérios em Baja O sonho de um homem rico de ter um paraíso à beira-mar no México se transforma em pesadelo após a polícia o encontrar brutalmente assassinado. Um triângulo amoroso, enganos e traição se desenrolam em um caso onde a ganância colide com ambição mortal.
programme.title: Férias Mortais

programme.desc: S2 E3 — Poderia Ser Você Amanhã Matima, estrela de dança do TikTok, e o estilista Quinton fazem sucesso nas redes. Mas eles não sabem que alguém os observa com inveja.
programme.title: Influência Mortal - Assassinatos nas Redes Sociais

programme.desc: S1 E6 — Troca de Primos Após uma infidelidade conjugal causar conflitos entre dois primos, os ânimos se exaltam. Movidos pela mágoa e o ciúme, eles se tornam inimigos declarados, dando lugar a uma disputa violenta que termina em tragédia.
programme.title: Rivalidades Fatais

programme.desc: S3 E8 — Treino Fatal A vida fitness cria uma rivalidade mortal em um grupo de fanáticos por exercícios.
programme.title: Garotas Malvadas

programme.desc: Special Uma agressão sexual choca uma pequena cidade, mas fica sem solução por 20 anos, até que um assassinato nas proximidades produz um suspeito com DNA correspondente.
programme.title: Inferno em Ozarks

programme.desc: Special A influenciadora Gabby Petito é dada como desaparecida e gera uma grande busca. Pela primeira vez, imagens dela com o parceiro são analisadas e especialistas identificam sinais de uma relação abusiva e da tragédia que viria.
programme.title: Crimes e Mentiras: O Assassinato de Gabby Petito

programme.desc: S13 E3 — Controle de Peso A nova confiança de Ashley enfurece Terry. Ele a persegue, pronto para retomar o controle do jeito mais mortal possível.
programme.title: Lobo em Pele de Cordeiro

programme.desc: S13 E9 — Faça um Desenho Elena se apaixona por Brandon, que parece um pai amoroso. Mas o ciúme e o controle violento dele levam a um desfecho devastador.
programme.title: Lobo em Pele de Cordeiro

programme.desc: S13 E8 — O Guardião do Meu Irmão Tymeir brilha como o filho amoroso, mas o ciúme do irmão Rodney leva a um ato brutal de violência que despedaça a família.
programme.title: Lobo em Pele de Cordeiro

programme.desc: S18 E2 — Meu Amor Colocou uma Arma na Minha Cabeça Dreamer conhece Teddy e ela vê um jovem destruído. Ela espera que seu amor o transforme. Em vez disso, ele retribui seu amor com medo, crueldade e controle. Depois que seu pai tenta ajudá-la a escapar, Teddy os faz pagar um preço terrível.
programme.title: Vivendo com o Inimigo

programme.desc: S18 E7 — Era Como Assistir a um Demônio Shaquoia e Imani conhecem Isiah e percebem uma maldade sinistra. Elas não entendem por que sua mãe namoraria um homem como ele. Shaquoia faz tudo o que pode para proteger seus irmãos da fúria de Isiah.
programme.title: Vivendo com o Inimigo

programme.desc: S18 E4 — Preso no Exterior com um Psicopata Eline começa a namorar Matthew, que parece gentil e charmoso, mas logo revela sua vida obscura e secreta. Quando ela percebe, Eline já tem um filho com um homem violento e cheio de raiva. E, quando ela o abandona, a fúria de Matthew explode.
programme.title: Vivendo com o Inimigo

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Casamento Frio Susan Winter, de Las Vegas, morre após ingerir fluido anticongelante. O caso é considerado um suicídio, mas os pais de Susan desconfiam que ela foi morta por seu marido Brent.
programme.title: Dose Fatal

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Esqueletos no Armário O uso de drogas de Brent é exposto e sua assistente e filha saem em sua defesa, alegando que Susan tinha um lado obscuro. Os registros telefônicos de Brent revelam mais mentiras e a equipe decide fazê-lo depor.
programme.title: Dose Fatal

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Dia de Reconhecimento Com o depoimento de Brent novas testemunhas pintam Susan como suicida. A equipe de Tony acredita que o computador desaparecido da família guarda evidências decisivas para o caso.
programme.title: Dose Fatal

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Êxodo Sherri Papini desaparece e retorna misteriosamente, com lesões e marcas pelo corpo. Ao descobrirem que sua história fascinante é falsa, o mundo se volta contra ela, mas Sherri afirma que a verdadeira história nunca foi contada.
programme.title: O Caso Sherri Papini

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Sou uma Mentirosa Sherri Papini fala pela primeira vez sobre as circunstâncias que levaram ao seu misterioso desaparecimento, explica por que mentiu para o FBI e os erros cometidos pela imprensa na cobertura do caso.
programme.title: O Caso Sherri Papini

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Verdades Múltiplas Após sair da prisão, detalhes perturbadores da infância e do casamento de Sherri Papini com Keith são revelados. A incapacidade de Sherri de recordar os detalhes de sua história provoca uma crise emocional.
programme.title: O Caso Sherri Papini

programme.desc: S1 E4 — É Complicado Pela primeira vez, Sherri conta o que aconteceu durante seu desaparecimento de 22 dias. Um teste de polígrafo a leva a mudar radicalmente sua versão. Duas confrontações finais complicam a busca pela verdade.
programme.title: O Caso Sherri Papini

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Still groggy from a visit to the dentist, Dr. Sloan is mystified when a noted fund-raiser dies while visiting his home. Adding to the confusion, the body mysteriously disappears before the police get there!

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: A cruel collage prank comes back to haunt four young women in later life. Although Amanda had almost forgotten it, a recent letter brings back the unpleasant memory.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: Chief Forbes starts a boxing program in Sparta to help young men at risk and has taken a special interest in one kid with a lot of promise, Kevin Brooks; however, Forbes soon discovers that Kevin is involved in a series of burglaries in town.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: Lieutenant Lonnie Jamison’s wealthy aunt, Cordelia Woodlin, is back in Sparta and spending time with her very old and dear friend, blues singer Ches Collins; that is until Ches starts receiving racist death threats warning him to stay away from her.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: Soon after Virgil Tibbs is hired by a local law firm, a pair of wealthy clients, the Bookers, are in a car accident; Chuck Booker survives, but Abby is killed. Chuck claims he was dodging a deer, but Tibbs suspects that Abby’s death was no accident.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: A new synagogue in Sparta is plagued by vandalism, but when the temple is destroyed and the sacred Torah is stolen, Rabbi Feldman refuses Sheriff Gillespie’s help based on a decades-old anti-Semitic crime that Gillespie apparently helped cover up.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: While trying to keep his buddy Justin out of trouble, Eugene Glendon jeopardizes his probation when he is seen leaving the scene of a robbery at a local gas station. Meanwhile, Eugene insists his mother Harriet choose between him and Bill Gillespie.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night

programme.desc: The Most Haunted team continue to investigate Macclesfield’s oldest pub and are soon under fire from poltergeist activity. Glen’s scepticism is put fully to the test.

programme.title: Ruthin Pt 1
programme.desc: This old Welsh Castle pushes Yvette’s team of ghost hunters to the limit and at least one of them doesn’t make it to the end…but who? Strange noises and sinister shadows seem to create an atmosphere of foreboding throughout the night.

programme.title: Ruthin Pt 2
programme.desc: The team continue their investigation into Ruthin Castle, as the activity gains momentum one of team is hit hard and has to leave, so the others go in search of whatever is there lurking…all is going well until they find it.

programme.title: Ancient High House
programme.desc: The team are followed around this ancient house said to be the haunt of many long dead spirits. The team are soon put to the test as Gregg feels something is playing with him.

programme.title: Leopard Inn Pt 1
programme.desc: The upper room of the Leopard Inn are now a set of deserted rooms and corridors that were once a Victorian Hotel, although way past its heyday some of the borders seem to have stayed. This episode sees the team get their most convincing evidence to date.

programme.title: Leopard Inn Pt 2
programme.desc: The team continue in the abandoned old hotel but something seems to be stalking them. Yvette has a close encounter alone in the corridors with disembodied footsteps walking toward her and aggressive poltergeist activity plagues the rest of the team

programme.title: Leopard Inn Pt 3
programme.desc: In the final part of their investigation into the abandoned old hotel above the Leopard Inn, Yvette and her team are tested again to their very limits.

programme.title: Most Haunted S24
programme.desc: Yvette starts the new series with an investigation at the haunted Eden Camp. Strange noises and an unknown force try to separate the team. Can they endure the entire investigation, or will the paranormal activity prove too much for them to handle?

programme.title: Most Haunted S24
programme.desc: Yvette and her world-famous team continue investigating Eden Camp. Splitting into lone vigils, they quickly regret it as lost souls, dark shadows, and disembodied voices haunt this living museum, all eager to make their presence known.

programme.title: Most Haunted S24
programme.desc: The Most Haunted team visit this deserted old mansion which is way past its original splendour. They are soon surrounded by unexplained activity as something is following them and for at least two members of crew, they are pushed to their very limits.

programme.title: Most Haunted S24
programme.desc: An all but deserted manor house that boasts murder, death and intrigue among its history becomes the setting for one of the most intriguing investigation to date. The team are showered with object that appear to land in the same way.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: Dust Child
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark must help an Amerasian girl facing racial prejudice when she goes to live with her father's family in the United States.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: Hotel Of Dreams

programme.desc: Jonathan steps in when a heart condition sidelines a promising basketball player's dreams.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: A Child of God

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: A Match Made in Heaven
programme.desc: Scotty is a lovelorn quadriplegic with a successful law practice. Jonathan is happy to play cupid, but Mark isn't so thrilled about it, because the woman in question is his cousin.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: The Banker and The Bum
programme.desc: A greedy banker and a good-hearted bum switch places. The bum dies, but the banker is now infused with love and generosity.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: The Brightest Star
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark meet a child star whose fame is spoiling her rotten, destroying her family and taking away her childhood.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: Investment In Caring
programme.desc: Jonathan encourages residents in a neighborhood to unite against a cold-hearted developer.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: The Right Thing
programme.desc: Jonathan inspires a young man to help the grandfather who has recently been placed in a nursing home.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: Thoroughbreds - Part 1
programme.desc: Lizzy MacGill is a horse trainer's young daughter who elopes with Garth Armstrong, a privileged man.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: Thoroughbreds - Part 2
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark try to help Lizzie. The new bride has cancer and she is pregnant.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: A Song for Jason - Part 1
programme.desc: Mark and Jonathan become counselors at a camp for children with cancer.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: A Song for Jason - Part 2
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark are helping patients at Camp Good Times in different ways. But a father still refuses to deal with his son's illness.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven: Bless the Boys in Blue
programme.desc: Jonathan relinquishes his angelic powers for awhile and realizes the dangers that Mark has faced being a police officer.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: Following the loss of their funding, the family are in dire financial straits. Danny and Ed attempt to get an extension on their mortgage but are refused. Fiona spurs Ed on, telling him that the man she used to know would have a plan for survival.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: Strange things are happening at Leopard's Den. The family awake to find frogs everywhere, seemingly having rained down overnight; the giraffe refuses to budge from the front gate and the cheetah is off its food.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Scabby Monkey
programme.desc: Contending with overweight cats and their over protective owners was not what Danny Trevanion had in mind when he became a vet. So when a scruffy, barely alive African monkey arrives at his practise Danny is fascinated by the challenge.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: New Year's Eve at Leopard's Den. Alice has returned, but the stress of combining work with caring for baby Bobby is causing tension between her and Danny. Liv is furious that Fatani hasn't told his mother about their relationship.

programme.title: Wild At Heart
programme.desc: Danny is having second thoughts about the wisdom of uprooting his new family and ploughing all their money into a business venture that they know next to nothing about.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Work To Do
programme.desc: A successful giraffe capture means everyone is in high spirits, until the arrival of Evan and Olivia's real father, Simon, throws the family into turmoil.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Meerly Evan
programme.desc: Evan lets the mischievous meerkats loose in Rosie's room to cause havoc. Rosie is devastated when they destroy an irreplaceable photograph of her mother and rages at Evan. She decides once and for all to go back to Bristol.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Evan Meets Elli
programme.desc: Rogue young male elephants are rampaging through Leopard's Den and destroying everything the family have built, so Danny introduces a matriarch elephant in the hope that she will calm them down.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Dawn Feeling
programme.desc: At a typically rowdy family breakfast, Rosie is excitedly looking forward to the arrival of her friend Izzy, whilst Danny is concerned about the rumour of ivory poachers in the area. Unnoticed, Miranda the lion cub pads off into the bush.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: The Trevanions have been living at Leopard's Den for over a year. The wildlife is roaming freely and the family are settled into African way of life. Business however is not good. With an abundance of game lodges competition is fierce.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: It's the grand reopening of Mara and a British wildlife charity is using the event to release a vulture back into the wild. Fatani, the new, young and ambitious manager of Mara has hired Danny as the vet to oversee the release.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Leopard's Den is looking after a sick and orphaned baby elephant called Togo. However, despite Evan and Du Plessis' constant vigil, Togo is dying from a broken heart. Evan is distraught and Du Plessis promises they will look after her together.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: Sarah's absence couldn't have come at a worse time for Leopard's Den. Nature Conservation is carrying out their annual inspection and everything has to be tip top. Danny's determined they pass with flying colours and everyone is roped in to help.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: Everyone's excited at the prospect of Leopard's Den's new arrival. Bash, Danny's old tutor and Rosie's Godfather, is coming from England to help Danny grow his veterinary practice.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: The Trevanions are delighted when Fatani asks Danny to take an aggressive hippo off his hands. As they prepare for its arrival Sarah gets a bit of a shock when her mother Caroline beats the hippo to the post.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: Business is looking up at Leopard's Den but Sarah is feeling agitated. Caroline thinks it because Simon, her ex husband and Evan and Olivia's Dad, is arriving from England to get married. But Sarah has other things on her mind.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Danny is undertaking a drugs trial at Leopard's Den. But de-worming wildebeest isn't Caroline's idea of fun. She hates animals and finds the whole business mind-numbingly boring.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: Du Plessis is in a foul mood. It's his 60th birthday and he has no intentions of celebrating it. But the Trevanions have other ideas and Caroline is organising a surprise party.

programme.title: World War II in HD Color

programme.title: World War II in HD Color

programme.desc: Japan continues its suicidal resistance, and invading it looks costly. After 2 atomic bombs, the Emperor intervenes and stops the War. Stalin grabs territory in East Asia. The War is over, and the Atomic Era and the Cold War start.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won and Lost
programme.desc: The battles of the first world war were battles of attrition and trenches; the battles of the second world war were vastly different. In this episode we study tank battles, blitzkrieg, commando raids, amphibious landings, and mobile warfare in the desert.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won and Lost
programme.desc: The second world war was conflict on an unprecedented scale. Its battles set new marks for the sheer size of forces deployed and for the power of their weapons. In this episode we study the first battle at sea, and the largest army to have ever marched.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won and Lost
programme.desc: A war that reached every continent and touched every sort of terrain demanded every sort of strategy. In this episode we examine battles fought at sea, and in the jungle, in city streets, invasions from the air, and retreats from the land.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won and Lost
programme.desc: Battles are almost always about territory. Advancing the front line, seizing the port, the city, the oil field. The fate of nations in the war rose and fell on battles that took territory. Singapore, Monte Casino, Stalingrad...all about territory.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won and Lost

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won and Lost
programme.desc: A world war is a patchwork of actions. Land. Sea. Air. Massive, or small scale. The stories of these actions, are just as varied. This episode describes battles of amphibious forces, climate, geography, and the problems of supply.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won and Lost
programme.desc: Through history, armies marched to face each other on favored ground and clashed to decide a campaign, a war, an empire. With the 20th century that changed. The battles of the WWII happened anywhere and everywhere, in every weather and climate.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won and Lost
programme.desc: Some words transcend their origins as humble place names. They are carved into history as turning points which influenced the course of WWII, the fate of nations, and the make-up of our world. El Alameine, Okinawa, and Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: South Park: South Park Is Gay
programme.desc: South Park is Gay! The TV show Queer Eye For The Straight Guy is sweeping the nation and the men of South Park are embracing metrosexuality, but what evil plan are the hosts plotting? (S7, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Christian Rock Hard
programme.desc: Christian Hard Rock: The boys form a band called Moop, but disagree on what direction they should take. Cartman leaves the band and bets them he will have a platinum record first! (S7, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Grey Dawn
programme.desc: Grey Dawn: There's an epidemic in South Park. An epidemic of senior citizen related driving accidents! When their licenses are all revoked they decide to fight back military style! (S7, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Casa Bonita
programme.desc: Casa Bonita: Cartman is overjoyed at going to a Mexican restaurant for Kyle's birthday but is crushed when he finds out Butters is invited instead. He'll have to make Butters "disappear". (S7, E11)

programme.title: South Park: All About Mormons
programme.desc: All About The Mormons: A new family moves to South Park and their son Gary is an unusually perfect Mormon - this angers the boys no end! Will Stan beat him up or go for a family dinner?! (S7, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Butt Out
programme.desc: Butt Out: When the boys' smoking leads to a nasty incident, it's the cigarettes that are blamed rather than them. Cue the glutinous Rob Reiner to arrive in town with his anti-smoking lobby! (S7, E13)

programme.title: South Park: Raisins
programme.desc: Raisins: When Wendy breaks up with Stan he takes it hard. The boys decide to take him to the restaurant Raisins, where all of the employees are preteen girls who enjoy wearing heavy make-up. (S7, E14)

programme.title: South Park: It's Christmas In Canada
programme.desc: It's Christmas In Canada: A law is passed in Canada, meaning poor lil' Ike must return to his biological parents. The boys set out to stop this but who is the evil mastermind behind the law? (S7, E15)

programme.title: South Park: Good Times with Weapons
programme.desc: Good Times With Weapons: After buying martial arts weapons at a local flea market, the boys are transformed into anime Japanese Warriors, with dire consequences for poor Professor Chaos. (S8, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter Than Summer: AWESOM-O
programme.desc: AWESOM-O: When Cartman disguises himself as a robot in order to play a prank on Butters, he ends up being used by movie execs to come up with film ideas and captured by the military! (S8, E05)

programme.title: South Park: Up the Down Steroid
programme.desc: Up The Down Steroid: Jimmy is due to take part in the Special Olympics but what dodgy substance is he talked into taking? Cartman fakes being disabled so he can enter and win a $1,000. (S8, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Goobacks
programme.desc: Goobacks: South Park is swamped by workers from the future, who take all the jobs for less pay. The men of South Park go to unusual lengths to stop them. "Dey turk err jurbs!" (S8, E07)

programme.title: A Haunting: Well To Hell
programme.desc: Mark Corvo finds a ceremonial alter in his attic. He reaches out to the Ghosts of New England Research Society for professional help. They believe tenants dabbling in the dark arts opened a portal to the other side and drew spirits to the location.

programme.title: A Haunting: When The Lights Go Out
programme.desc: After newlyweds Brooke and Dominic Ardolino experience strange paranormal events in their home, they call in investigators who uncover two spirits – one is trying to warn them while the other is dangerous.

programme.title: A Haunting: The Haunting of Summerwind

programme.title: A Haunting: Vision Of Terror

programme.title: A Haunting: Mind Control

programme.title: A Haunting: The Dark Side

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Gary plans a life-changing surprise for Emma. Holly goes to see some unicorns. Sophie struggles to forget her ex and Marnie has a traumatic labour. (S2, ep2)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Sophie gets ready to celebrate her 30th birthday in style. Marnie adjusts to her new life. Holly takes Jacob shopping and Gary prepares to go down on one knee. (S2, ep3)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Marnie's illness catches up with her. Gary takes Aaron "Dad training" and Sophie receives some devastating news. (S2, ep4)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Aaron gets called out at an MMA fight. Marnie is finally ready to have visitors and Holly and Jacob throw an epic engagement party. (S2, ep5)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Aaron takes up golf with hilarious results. Sophie makes a life changing purchase. Holly has a fitness photo shoot and Marnie & Casey have their first date since Rox's birth. (S2, ep6)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Holly prepares to meet one of her trolls. Gary and Emma's second baby arrives early. Sophie shows off her new house and Marnie & Casey fall out at the pool. (S2, ep7)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Aaron welcomes his son into the world, but there's some bad news for his relationship. Holly takes a trip to secure a wedding venue and Marnie sees her mum for the first time since lockdown. (S3, ep1)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: After leaving Geordie Shore; Aaron, Marnie and Holly continue their journey through adult life. No more shots & kebabs, it's all about wedding planning, changing nappies and being grown ups. (S3, ep2)
programme.sub-title: I'm Sexy and I Know It

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: A hospital visit thaws tensions between Aaron and Talia. Holly goes shopping for bridesmaid dresses and Casey hatches a plan behind Marnie's back. (S3, ep3)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Aaron meets Talia to try and save their relationship. Holly goes on the hunt for her wedding dress and Casey is nearly ready to pop the question... there's just one thing missing. (S3, ep4)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Holly debates taking Jacob's name, Aaron and Talia have couples counselling and the time has come for Casey to propose to Marnie. Will he hold his nerve? (S3, ep5)
programme.sub-title: I Think I Wanna Marry You

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Marnie's illness takes a dramatic turn for the worse, Aaron and Talia make a massive step in the right direction and Holly hits the hat shop with her mam. (S3, ep6)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Marnie and Casey return to the scene of an old argument. Aaron hits the dirt bike track and Holly comes face to face with the past at her hen party. (S3, ep7)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: The OGs are back but will Aaron and Talia's relationship survive a new baby? Will Marnie and Casey stay strong after a recent split? Will Holly and Jacob ever get married? (S4, ep1)

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Get This Party Started!
programme.desc: The Geordie's are buzzing to be back in the house and most of them are single. Two newbies, Amelia and Ant, are shown how to tear up the Toon. Nathan and Beau get too close for Bethan. (S21, ep1)

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Family Friction!
programme.desc: The squad are in a good place, tearing up the Toon and having fun welcoming the newbies. But, it all kicks off when Chloe ignores Nathan's advice about getting too close to new boy, Ant. (S21, ep2)

programme.title: Geordie Shore: It's Fright Night!
programme.desc: Chloe's feelings start to drift, but Ant thinks there's a chance when she lets him stay in her bed. The squad go on a forest Fright Night walk where Abbie and Chloe are forced to talk. (S21, ep3)

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Hello New Lad!
programme.desc: New boy Louis joins the squad and makes a sudden impact. Chloe falls for his charm which puts Ant's nose out of joint. Bethan tells Beau she needs more of his time. (S21, ep4)

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Big Mistake!
programme.desc: Chloe necks on with Ant to teach Louis a lesson. Beau and Bethan have a heart to heart, they agree the day is for friends and the night is for them. Beau gets drunk and messes things up! (S21, ep5)

programme.title: Geordie Shore: See Ya, Nat!
programme.desc: Nat's not been feeling herself and after a lot of soul searching, she decides to leave for good. Beau and Bethan are at breaking point and have a tense conversation about their future. (S21, ep6)

programme.title: JAG: War Cries
programme.desc: In Lima, Peru, while a boy sneaks into the US embassy at night, a Marine guard stops him.

programme.title: JAG: Sightings
programme.desc: In south Texas, residents have reported strange phenomena, stories of supernatural events have abounded, and a 10-year-old girl has disappeared.

programme.title: JAG: Scimitar
programme.desc: Two Marines in a Humvee mistakenly drive into Iraq; an Iraqi detail intercepts them, kills one, and captures the other.

programme.title: JAG: Defensive Action
programme.desc: A patrolling F-14 malfunctions in a no-fly zone; the crew ejects, and the bird explodes.

programme.title: JAG: Boot.
programme.desc: A woman Marine recruit dies at Parris Island. Harm investigates while Meg poses undercover as a recruit.

programme.title: JAG: The Brotherhood
programme.desc: During a landing exercise Marines find a beaten, comatose fellow Marine on the beach

programme.title: JAG: Hemlock
programme.desc: By mistake a foreign agent sends a fax to Meg's office; then he retrieves it and shoots Meg to prevent her from identifying him

programme.title: JAG: High Ground
programme.desc: A Marine sniper receives orders contrary to a previous deal; his CO refuses to listen; the sniper takes a shot at the CO's Humvee.

programme.title: JAG: Smoked
programme.desc: After a lightning strike, an F-14 wanders into Cuban airspace, and Cuban fighters force it to land

programme.title: JAG: Black Ops
programme.desc: A Naval aviator, while temporarily assigned to a SEAL team, drowns at sea; he was the son of a woman senator.

programme.title: JAG: Survivors
programme.desc: In a civilian court Harm represents a divorced (and emotionally baffled) Marine colonel, who has gotten into trouble over an unauthorized visit with his minor son.

programme.title: JAG: Recovery
programme.desc: A Navy astronaut dies during a drill while preparing for a space mission to repair a satellite

programme.title: JAG: Prisoner
programme.desc: Chicom agents capture Harm in Hong Kong; they vigorously question him in mainland China about official matters.

programme.title: JAG: Ares
programme.desc: Someone kills a Naval officer on Okinawa, then his ship encounters major trouble during war games at sea

programme.title: JAG: Skeleton Crew
programme.desc: The body of a woman Naval officer, a friend, and classmate of Harm, is found ashore.

programme.title: JAG: Trinity
programme.desc: Harm and his new partner, Marine Major Sara MacKenzie are drawn into a game of revenge when they're sent to Belfast, Ireland, to represent the legal interests of a Navy Lieutenant whose infant son has seemingly been abducted.

programme.title: JAG: Secrets

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Through the Looking Glass
programme.desc: A new inter-dimensional portal system for human travel turns out to be something more when the resistance discover a CVI in a boy who got lost in the system.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Infection
programme.desc: Ne'eg is killed by a bacteria that is both deadly to Taelons and Humans. If it spreads, it might be disastrous. A new racist group attacks a community center.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Destruction
programme.desc: The Liberation sends a team to destroy the scarecrow probe before the Taelons crack it. Joshua Doors is appointed as secretary of Human-Taelon relations.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: The Joining
programme.desc: An excavation team unleashes a very dangerous Taelon on Earth. Siobhan Beckett comes over to America. She suspects Lili of being a spy and investigates.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: First of its Kind
programme.desc: Following Boone's confrontation with Hegel that left him severely injured, he was eliminated by Zo'or. Beckett who was impregnated by Hegel gives birth to a boy who immediately grows up to a man.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Avatus
programme.desc: Da'an looses his contact with the the Taelon Commonality. This causes him to change and Zo'or instructs that Da'an must be killed; because he's now considered a threat.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: A Stitch in Time
programme.desc: An exhibition for the first arrival of the Taelons showcases different artifacts. An artifact causes Liam to travel to an alternate time. Zo'or questions how Da'an was able to rejoin the Commonality.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Dimensions
programme.desc: Liam and Augur are in a Taelon shuttle craft, when something happens they get thrown into a parallel universe. They discover that humanity is at war with the Taelons.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Moonscape
programme.desc: Augur is forced to take part in a Taelon experiment. Da'an and Liam try to convince Zo'or that altering minds and implanting humans to make them aggressive to fight the Jaridians is not the correct path. Maiya makes contact with Sandoval.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: The Sleepers
programme.desc: A Jaridian probe lands on Earth and begins sucking energy from the Comonality. The Taelons use humans in a near-death state to keep their connection while Lili and Sandoval try to find out what is draining the energy.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Fissures
programme.desc: When large scale blackouts begin to occur in cities with portals, Taelon technology is blamed. Augur and Liam investigate the death of a portal worker by a strange creature that feeds on energy and is particularly attracted to the Taelons.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Redemption
programme.desc: Siobhan falls while rock climbing. As the others search for her, she dreams that she is on trial for supporting the Taelons. Zo'or questions whether Sandoval's CVI imperative to serve the Taelons has broken down as others are experiencing.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Between Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: Dr. Belman's daughter does human testing on herself with an accelerant that causes her to rapidly evolve. Joshua Doors decides somebody should run against President Thompson in the election, somebody who will stand up to the Taelons.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Isabel
programme.desc: Maiya experiences dimensional phasing. Augur and Liam believe they need to bring Isabel and Maiya together to let the universe merge them. Jonathan Doors announces his presidential candidacy and meets with Zo'or.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict
programme.desc: An escaped Jiridian takes Lili hostage. Their shuttle is sucked on to a Kimera ship where they, with Liam, have to go through an obstacle course to get to the core to exit.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict
programme.desc: Using Jiridian technology, scientists create a physical bio surrogates where a human consciousness can be transferred. When a surrogate escapes, they must find it before it uses its fighting and weapons knowledge.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Second Chances
programme.desc: A Taelon program offers a transformation into a younger, healthier version of oneself. Liam fears that something more dangerous is also happening. Lili is worried that Doors' run for the presidency is negatively affecting the resistance.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Payback
programme.desc: A mysterious death by poisoning creates questions about the safety of portal technology. When a Taelon is killed in the same manner, the investigation leads to a very smart scientist that even the Resistance was scared to work with.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Friendly Fire
programme.desc: Paul Chandler plots an attack on the Taelon Embassy in DC with the ship he stole from Lili. He begs her to join him in beginning an all out war.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Volunteers
programme.desc: A group of Resistance capture a volunteer from a Taelon program for youth. Liam decides they may learn valuable information from her. They also decide to send in one of their own as a volunteer to see what the program is teaching.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Bliss
programme.desc: Lili is given a psychotropic drug called "bliss" via a Taelon device. They discover it is widespread. With an instantly strong addictive property, the addicts are dying within 48 hours. The investigation leads Liam and Sandoval to Ireland.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Highjacked
programme.desc: With a reporter on board, the Taelon mother ship is highjacked into interdimensional space. Liam is the prime suspect, causing an even bigger rift between Da'an and Zo'or. As the ship floats, lost in space, they must find the real culprit.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Quentin Tarantino

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Spider-Man
programme.desc: The push for action leaves the team scrambling to come up with new ways of doing things. But just when the team is ready to kick off the superhero genre, a tragedy derails their plans.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Spider-Man

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Spider-Man

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Spider-Man
programme.desc: Spider-man comes home to Marvel, but can Marvel and Sony get along enough to keep him there? The franchise comes full circle, bringing everyone back together in a time of crisis.

programme.desc: J.R.R Tolkien’s children’s book and trilogy take the world by storm, appealing to the fans its author would least expect. After several failed attempts to adapt the books and one half-successful animated movie, an unlikely hero takes on the film.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: The Lord of the Rings
programme.desc: With the clock ticking Peter Jackson has to find a studio to save his work in progress. Only one studio is willing to take the gamble on three films made at once adapting an unwanted property led by an unproven director on the other side of the world.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: The Lord of the Rings
programme.desc: After a successful teaser at Cannes, the team races to complete the first film on time. Meanwhile filming begins to take a toll on the cast and crew. As injuries pile up, the most demanding scene in the trilogy nearly breaks them.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: The Lord of the Rings
programme.desc: The trilogy hinges on the technological magic being developed at WETA but internal strife threatens to bring the whole thing crashing down. As the saga reaches its conclusion Peter Jackson is reluctant to let go.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: The Lord of the Rings
programme.desc: The studio that backed the films takes a gamble too far. Peter Jackson struggles in vain to avoid the burden of directing. In the midst of a grueling shoot one of the dwarves is sent packing.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: The Lord of the Rings
programme.desc: Peter Jackson pushes the bounds both on the page and on screen. But will audiences like what they see? A legendary chapter comes to a close leaving its mark on the film industry.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Tom Cruise

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Tom Cruise
programme.desc: Tom Cruise enters the danger zone as Tony Scott pushes the limits of the Navy and his actors to achieve his sun-kissed vision.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Tom Cruise
programme.desc: Having proved he’s a star, Tom now wanted to test himself as an actor. While remaining in the shadow of Dustin Hoffman’s performance in Rain Man, Tom is able to get his first Oscar nomination by breaking out of his mold in Born on the 4th of July.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Tom Cruise
programme.desc: Tom’s next two films will launch the careers of everyone around him while nearly delivering him that elusive Oscar. A Few Good Men is once again a win for Jack Nicholson rather than Tom, but Jerry Maguire brings him in reach of the Oscar.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Tom Cruise
programme.desc: Tom Cruise tests his limits, becoming a producer and taking on ever riskier stunts. But it’s his personal life that nearly sends his career spinning.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Play It Again, Santa
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) goes undercover with Det. Jonah Newman (guest star Dan Shor) to investigate a series of disappearing Santa Clauses and issues with music rights. Also starring Tyne Daly as Mary Beth Lacey and Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: The Rapist
programme.desc: When Lacey goes out on maternity leave, Cagney's is given a temporary partner temporary partner, Sara Jones. Jones becomes obsessed with a rape investigation and increasingly frustrated with the length of time it is taking to arrest the suspect.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Act Of Conscience
programme.desc: While Lacey is on maternity leave, Cagney is assigned a controversial new partner who's past of turning in other cops who have participated in illegal activity makes the rest of the 14th precinct question how long he will stay among them.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: D.W.I.
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) goes undercover with Det. Jonah Newman (guest star Dan Shor) to investigate a series of disappearing Santa Clauses and issues with music rights. Also starring Tyne Daly as Mary Beth Lacey and Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: The Gimp
programme.desc: While investigating a series of muggings of disabled persons, Cagney (Sharon Gless) gets a first-hand look at the problems they face and becomes romantically involved with a man (guest star James Stacy) who is handicapped and advocating for change.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Family Connections
programme.desc: Cagney has to rush to Lacey's side at the hospital, hoping that she can make it before the baby is delivered. Being around Lacey and her family makes Cagney have second thoughts about her life as a singleton. Cagney's father has a new girlfriend.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Post Partum
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) becomes involved in a case where a West Point cadet is charged with possession of cocaine and is refusing to help himself due to his honor code. Meanwhile, Lacey's (Tyne Daly) father pays her a visit after a 30-year absence.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Man Who Shot Trotsky
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) receive a second opportunity to nail a notorious narcotics dealer as Petrie (Carl Lumbly) and Isbecki (Martin Kove) go 'off-Broadway' to pursue a murder case. Also starring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Exit Stage Center (S04E19)
programme.desc: When a famous actress dies, the first assumption is suicide. However, as Cagney and Lacey investigate, they soon discover that she was murdered and everyone in the cast and crew of the play she was in has a probable motive for killing her.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Capitalism
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) investigate the murder of a prominent and well-respected Cambodian immigrant lawyer and discover his business might not be as it appears. Also starring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Extradition
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are sent to Los Angeles to extradite an old 'perp' as Cagney meets her brother Brian's (guest star David Ackroyd) family for the first time in 12 years. Also starring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: A Safe Place
programme.desc: When a vial of plutonium is stolen from a scientist, Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) run up against government barriers trying to locate the lethal radioactive material before the thief becomes terminally ill.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Model Citizen
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) investigate the gangland-style murder of a highly respected union leader, making everyone question why a man with a spotless record would be murdered in the first place. Also starring Al Waxman.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Parting Shots
programme.desc: Detective Jonah Newman (guest star Dan Shor) is gunned down in front of his fellow detectives who must find the killer while coming to grips with the loss of their colleague and the danger of their jobs. Starring Sharon Gless and Tyne Daly.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: You Call This Plainclothes?
programme.desc: After a series of murders take place involving prostitutes, Cagney (Meg Foster) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) go undercover in the hopes of finding who keeps killing the women. Also starring Al Waxman, Carl Lumbly, and John Karlen.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Pop Used To Work In Chinatown
programme.desc: A Chinatown robbery brings Cagney's retired father back on the beat to show his daughter how to properly conduct an investigation. Guest starring Dick O'Neill as Charlie Cagney. Tyne Daly, Meg Foster, Al Waxman, and Carl Lumbly star.
programme.sub-title: Pop Used To Work In Chinatown

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Beyond The Golden Door
programme.desc: In the hopes of finding a missing child, Cagney (Meg Foster) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) go undercover as workers in the garment industry and end up helping an undocumented worker from Guatemala find her sister's murderer.

programme.desc: Ralph receives a job offer in the city, and Ranger Dan is given a similar chance. Bert worries the group will split apart and be unable to stop Cyril’s plans, forcing everyone to decide whether to follow opportunity or stay together.

programme.title: The Raccoons

programme.title: The Raccoons

programme.title: The Raccoons

programme.title: The Raccoons

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach
programme.desc: Miles, la nueva celebridad deja una gran impresión en Marissa. David se disfraza y las chicas tienen que tomar una decisión difícil.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach

programme.title: La ola
