programme.desc: Louie turns into a jealous romantic when his overtures to accompany Elaine on her European vacation are rejected. Instead, Alex becomes the pretty cabbie's holiday companion on a tour of Europe's hot spots—culminating in a romantic rendezvous.

programme.desc: Riotous confusion prevails when Latka Gravas' split personalities prompt Elaine and Alex to take him to a psychiatrist's office, where the predicament takes on a wild new twist as Latka takes on Alex's personality.

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: A jubilant Tony returns to boxing as the manager of a young heavyweight, thrilling Louie, who anticipates recouping his wagering losses to Alex by betting against Banta's boxer.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Louie carries his actions and insults too far, prompting Elaine to enlist help from a women's organization. Soon, the dispatcher's lecherous laughter is transformed into comical pleading when he is booted out of his job.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Joy blossoms at the Sunshine Cab Co. when a triumphant Bobby Wheeler returns to proclaim that he's landed a TV series role. Louie, in his own charming way, puts a damper on the celebration.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The pretty new cabbie proves to be more than Alex can handle when she leaves the meter running, in an attempt to lure him into romance.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Romance and merriment are on the menu for Tony and Alex when they double-date gorgeous twin models at a posh restaurant, only to have the intimate group grow to a crowd with the unwelcome additions of Jim and Alex's ex-wife.

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Ring the bells! Spread the word! Latka Gravas and Simka Dahblitz are getting married, and the dingy Sunshine Cab Co. garage is transformed into a chapel of beauty for the social event of the cabbies' season.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Tree Of Life
programme.desc: An exclusive fertility clinic is much more than it seems. It is run by a cult of female Druids who use a cursed fertility statue to expand their numbers.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: 13 O'clock
programme.desc: A cursed pocket watch lets its owner stop time for one hour, and a vicious pair of killers get hold of it.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Scarecrow
programme.desc: One of the local farmers uses a cursed scarecrow. She must pin the pictures of three victims on the scarecrow's chest. When it claims all three victims, the result is a good harvest.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Tails I Live, Heads You Die
programme.desc: A Satanic cult leader acquires a cursed coin that can kill with a flip and use the life force to resurrect the dead. When one member of the trio dies, the other two wonder if they can carry on.
programme.sub-title: Tails I Live, Heads You Die

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: The Long Road Home
programme.desc: Micki and Johnny recover a yin-yang amulet that lets the user switch bodies after killing someone. They steal it from a wife and her lover trying to kill her husband and manage to escape

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Faith Healer
programme.desc: Jack is asked by a friend to investigate a faith healer who uses a cursed glove to heal one person...by transferring their ills magnified tenfold to another victim.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Wedding Bell Blues
programme.desc: While Ryan and Jack try to recover a pair of cursed snowshoes, Micki hears from one of Ryan's street contacts, a punk named Johnny. He's managed to track down a pool cue that bears a curse.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: My Wife As A Dog
programme.desc: A lonely fireman is obsessed with his dog, loving it more than his wife. He can fulfill his fondest wish when he finds a cursed dog leash that lets him slowly merge his wife and his dog into one being.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Eye Of Death
programme.desc: An antiques collector, Atticus Rook, makes a fortune selling as-new antiques from the Civil War era. It turns out that they are as-new by fuelling a cursed magic lantern with the blood of a victim

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Vidkun Quisling

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Special Forces operate deep behind enemy lines with top-of-the-line weapons.Host Wil Willis tests the Sig Sauer P226, the preferred choice like the Mark 25 by Navy SEALs, against competitors like the H&K Compact Tactical.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Devil's Due
programme.desc: During WWII, Greek Prime Ministers Tsolakoglou, Logothetopoulos, and Rallis collaborated with Nazi occupiers, imposing fees that caused a famine.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Becoming Respectable
programme.desc: In 1924, Hitler is convicted for High Treason after the failed Nazi power grab. In prison, he writes Mein Kampf, articulating his anti-Semitic and expansionist beliefs. Upon release, Hitler rebrands the Nazi Party.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Final Solution
programme.desc: This is the story of how Hitler orchestrated the genocide of 6 million Jews. Hitler portrayed Jews as a societal threat, using Goebbels' propaganda. Deportations were masked as resettlements while Auschwitz-Birkenau became a death factory.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: The Gathering Storm
programme.desc: The activities of nations after World War I that lead to World War II.

programme.desc: Monty heads to Slovenia to retrace one of the most daring, yet unknown, mass escapes of Allied prisoners during the second world war, made possible only with the help of partisans and locals.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Grand Mufti
programme.desc: The controversy surrounding Mohammad Amin al-Husayni, stems from his Nazi collaboration. He recruited Bosnian Muslims and advocated for a Palestinian homeland with Nazi help. His diaries reveal awareness of the Holocaust and anti-Semitic sentiments.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Misfits Gather
programme.desc: Hitler finds his political destiny in post-war Munich. He quickly dominates a fringe party & builds it into the Nazi Party. He recruits infamous men to the cause including Herman Goering & Heinrich Himmler & they plot a coup known as the Beerhall Putsch.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Mike wants Dan to make his prized Mach 1 even more of a muscle car. Richard brings FantomWorks the first ‘his and hers’ restoration – a Sunbeam Tiger and a Fiat Spider – but as Dan soon discovers; the challenges of the two cars are not equal.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas are working in the paint booth on the Malicious Intent. The 1966 Mustang is sanding out the car to get it ready for the paint booth. The 86 Camaro is being converted into a sniper system under the hood.

programme.title: The Ride Life
programme.desc: Despite a troubled past of poverty and invasions, Korea has emerged as a car building power-house. Through its unheralded and talented-loaded car scene, Sung reconnects with the land of his birth and finds peace with his estranged mother.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Cuda 'Tat
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Emmett believes his 1964 Barracuda is all original. But Dan finds out that the car has hidden damage and a past that nobody expected. Velvet wants Dan to get her 1953 Studebaker Commander running as a surprise for her husband, Travis.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Mike’s 1939 Hudson Coupe-Convertible is the only survivor of three that were built. He wants Fantomworks to restore it to original condition – even though nobody knows what that looks like. Jim wants his 1970 Nova to be the ultimate dragster.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas install airbags on the 48 Dodge. Team gets ready for the Galveston Classic Car show.

programme.title: The Ride Life
programme.desc: Sung's dive into the world's car cultures takes him to Poland, a country that emerged from a repressive communist era. Sung finds that new freedoms have led to an explosion of optimist and energy, and one of the most exciting experiences of his life.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: What We Do for a Buck
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.
programme.sub-title: What We Do for a Buck

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: George wants his 1967 Chevelle to be perfect, but his car has had more rats than repairs and the engine bay is too small for his dreams. Brian’s 1960 Lincoln is full of surprises, and he moment something else is fixed, a new problem surfaces.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: FantomWorks dives into prototype hell to give Nick a superfast 1969 Chevrolet Chevelle with an LT4 engine. Barlen wants his mother’s 1957 Chevrolet Bel Air to run like a dream for her birthday. Unfortunately, her birthday is in 30 days.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Kansas City Royals pitcher Tim Collins wants a ‘super-fast’ 1968 Mustang, but Dan has to first undo a nightmare combination of bad repairs and unsafe systems. Bob needs a FantomWorks reality check to get his beloved 1950 Willy’s Jeep back on the road.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Rick comes to FantomWorks for a nightmare combination of gadgets, gizmos, and upgrades for his 1972 Cadillac Hearse. Merlyn and Lynn are farmers from Minnesota with a 1959 Chevy Apache that’s so dangerous they’ve never driven it beyond their driveway.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan and the team take on the restorations of a 1965 Mustang fastback and a 1951 Studebaker truck. The mustang is for a friend whose plans are far bigger than his budget, and the Studebaker needs a unique design to make it a world-class show vehicle.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Ron and Valerie want Dan to restore their 1963 Jeep Willy’s Fleetvan, but the problems run deeper than the seams hidden beneath inches of filler. Grady’s Z28 breaks down so often that he’s never had it out of second gear.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Kim and Doug want to drive her father’s hyper-rare 1959 Thunderbolt, but the car was only set up for the racetrack. Batalla is a legendary motorcycle builder who asks Dan to restore his prized possession - a 1947 Knucklehead.

programme.title: The Ride Life
programme.desc: Sung heads to the UK, home to some of the world's most iconic car brands like Land Rover, Rolls Royce, and Jaguar. It's a land rich in history, but as Sung explores the car culture's grass roots, he finds the people who make it so memorable.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: The 48 Dodge 4 door coupe are ready for the airbags to be installed. The 66 Corvette has a custom frame that is unique to Muscle Cars of Texas.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Walter loves the fast and futuristic look of his 1975 Bricklin. Unfortunately, the car drives like something from the dark ages. Dan restores a 1963 Split Window Corvette for a pair of owners who know him well – his Uncle Carl and Aunt Claire.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Taming a 1971 Challenger R/T
programme.desc: A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.

programme.desc: All støy utenfra overdøves mens en populær sang hele tiden spilles veldig høyt, og bare i hodet til Allison. Sangen gir Allison ledetråder til lokasjonen til en savnet student.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drømmer om at hun er en kvinne som er innlagt på en mentalinstitusjon i 1959. Allison oppdager så at kvinnen fra drømmen hennes påsto å være Allison DuBois, som levde i 2005.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allisons nye vane med å gå i søvne setter henne stadig i farlige situasjoner. Det gjør henne utslitt, men hun presser seg selv for å løse en kidnappingssak før det er for sent.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drømmer om en gammel ungdomsskolevenninne og bestemmer seg for å finne henne. I mellomtiden søker en mann distriktsadvokatens hjelp til å finne datteren sin som har vært savnet i en uke.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison hjelper distriktsadvokaten med å fange en morder hvis advokat også bruker en synsk, samtidig som han prøver å forhindre skyting på påtalemyndighetens kontor.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Joe sitter i juryen i en sak mot en mann anklaget for å ha myrdet sin rike kone. Allison begynner å få syner om mannen, men statsadvokat Devalos beordrer henne til å ikke jobbe med saken.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison har en visjon som kan sette Devalos' sjanser for gjenvalg i fare. I mellomtiden møter Joe en ekskjæreste fra college.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drømmer om å kjøre på en jente med bilen sin og om en kvinne med et hjemsøkt hus. Hun finner ut at kvinnen har dødd av selvmord.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison kan ikke få en psykotisk morder ut av hodet sitt, noe som får Joe til å bekymre seg for døtrenes velvære.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Doktorens ånd fra episoden "Penny for your Thoughts" er tilbake og er ute etter Allisons datter Ariel.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison hjelper til med å finne et savnet barn. Etterpå har hun en visjon om barnets fremtid og er ikke lenger sikker på hva hun skal gjøre for å hjelpe barnet.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drømmer at broren hennes var involvert i et lokalt bankran. Mistankene hennes vokser når han uventet dukker opp i byen og blir involvert med en svindler.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison etterforsker tilsynelatende tilfeldige drap, og setter familien hennes i fare. Bridgette må holde en presentasjon om morens jobb for klassen.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Tre jenter blir funnet drept. Allisons syner kobler etterforsker Scanlon til saken.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drømmer gjentatte ganger om en kvinne som blir overvåket av en fremmed mann på soverommet hennes.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison er opptatt med å etterforske dødsfallet til en lokal lege når en mann som hevder å være "Døden" begynner å dukke opp i synene hennes, noe som får henne til å frykte at hun snart skal dø.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drømmer om livet hun kunne hatt hvis hun hadde blitt advokat, som hun opprinnelig ønsket å bli.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allisons gamle flamme, Clay Bicks, dukker opp på dørstokken hennes straks etter sin bortgang, uvitende om at han er død.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison og Bridgette fortsetter å ha de samme rare drømmene, og Allison kommer nærmere å finne ut hva drømmene betyr og hvordan de kobles til en serie drap.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drømmer om den samme dagen om og om igjen. Hver gang finner hun viktigere ledetråder. Joe prøver å få oppmerksomhet fra Allison. Ariel har problemer på skolen.

programme.title: Dynasty: Acapulco
programme.desc: Jeff begynner å bli svimmel og dårlig av den giftige malingen Adam brukte på kontoret. Joseph ber Kirby holde seg unna Jeff.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Locket
programme.desc: Carrington-familien får høre at Stevens oljerigg har eksplodert. Blake drar for å lete etter ham, sammen med en ubuden Alexis.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Search
programme.desc: Alexis og Blake fortsetter letingen etter Steven i Indonesia, men finner bevis for at Steven kan være død. Blake nekter å tro det og hyrer en synsk person, Jason Denner, for å få hjelp.

programme.title: Dynasty: Samantha
programme.desc: Blake fortsetter sin febrilske leting etter Steven i Denver ved hjelp av synske Jason Denner. Blake nekter å tro at sønnen er død, og Krystle er bekymret over den ustabile oppførselen hans.

programme.title: Dynasty: Danny
programme.desc: En åpenbart syk Jeff er forvirret. Sammy Jo kunngjør at hun skal til New York for å gjøre det stort som modell, og at hun ikke lenger vil beholde sønnen, Danny.

programme.title: Dynasty: Madness
programme.desc: Jeffs humør blir stadig mer ustabilt. Adam prøver å trekke Jeff inn i skandalen med Cecil Colby/Logan Rhinewood.

programme.title: Dynasty: Two Flights To Haiti
programme.desc: Selv om Blake ber henne om å vente med å gjøre noe før Jeffs voldelige oppførsel kan forklares, flyr Fallon til Haiti for å skille seg. Mark dukker uventet opp på hotellet hennes.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Mirror
programme.desc: Alexis er bekymret for at legene skal finne ut sannheten om Jeffs sykdom, men Adam prøver å dekke over ved å få kontoret pusset opp og fjerne den livsfarlige malingen.

programme.title: Dynasty: Battle Lines
programme.desc: Krystle mistenker at Alexis vet årsaken til Jeffs sykdom. Blake prøver å forhindre Alexis' foreslåtte sammenslåing. Jeff blir utskrevet fra sykehuset, og Kirby avslører sine følelser for ham.

programme.title: Reunion in Singapore
programme.desc: Blake reiser til Singapore for å identifisere sønnen, og Alexis dukker opp på flyplassen for å forsikre ham om at hun ikke vil la seg stanse i å fusjonere selskapene deres.

programme.title: Dynasty: Fathers and Sons
programme.desc: Blake overtaler Steven til å returnere til Denver for sønnens skyld. Nyheten om at Steven lever og kommer hjem setter følelsene i sving hos Carrington-familien.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Downstairs Bride
programme.desc: Da han får høre at Kirby har giftet seg med Jeff, forteller Joseph datteren at hun har ødelagt livet sitt. Blake foreslår at han og Alexis skal inngå våpenvile i kampen om Steven.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Vote
programme.desc: Da styret samles for å stemme over fusjonen mellom Denver-Carrington og Colbyco, kunngjør Alexis at de som stemmer nei får sparken omgående.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Dinner
programme.desc: Blake konfronterer Alexis med bevis på falske tall som ble brukt i den nylige fusjonen. Alexis finner ut at Blakes lukrative oljeutvinningsprosess ikke omfatter Colbyco.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Threat
programme.desc: En skandaløs avisoverskrift kobler kongressmedlemmet McVane til en ung jente i Washington. Han innser at Alexis står bak. Kirby finner ut at hun er gravid.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Cabin
programme.desc: Når Blake får vite at Stevens advokat, Chris, har flyttet sammen med sønnen, sverger han på kjempe for omsorgen for lille Danny.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Arrest
programme.desc: Krystle og Alexis, som er innesperret en brennende hytte langt uti skogen, finner ut at døren er låst – fra utsiden. Mark redder de to kvinnene på dramatisk vis.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Bungalow
programme.desc: Mark blir siktet for drap og brannstiftelse. Alexis forteller Blake og politiet at han ville hevne seg. De andre mistenkte i saken, McVane, Hess og Adam, blir avhørt og løslatt.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Note
programme.desc: Alexis får en beskjed fra avdøde Joseph – han startet brannen for å drepe henne. Claudia slipper ut fra sanatoriet. Steven og Blake slåss om lille Danny.

programme.desc: Den første nakne nybegynneren truer umiddelbart forbindelsene. Mens visse forbindelser vokser, tviles det på andre, noe som skaper spenning før en dater dumpes permanent.

programme.title: Dating Naked UK
programme.desc: Daterne søker stadig forbindelser etter den første dumpingen. Det er fritt fram for nye forbindelser da andre brytes. En omgang 'Dare or Bare' gjør at en dater angrer mens tiden tikker for ei av jentene.

programme.title: Dating Naked UK
programme.desc: Det slår gnister når sjalusi og konkurranse tilspisser seg. Et par tar forbindelsen til et nytt nivå, mens tvilens skjær sprer seg over det andre. Før en dramatisk vri på avfallsplassen.

programme.title: Dating Naked UK

programme.title: Dating Naked UK
programme.desc: Et par settes på den ytterste prøven da nok en nybegynner kommer. De uten sterke forbindelser føler seg også sårbare.

programme.title: Dating Naked UK
programme.desc: Fjærene blir rufset til i en ny kamp om jentene. Dom og Mike fortsetter videre. Og en fest sendt fra himmelen, ender i en helvetes overraskelse.

programme.title: Dating Naked UK
programme.desc: To kjente fjes vil absolutt gjenopprette forbindelsene, men er de i stand til å fortsette der de slapp? Daterne skjemmes bort i en dampende, bakvendt striptease. Dette styrker visse, svekker andre og genererer en havarert forbindelse.

programme.title: Dating Naked UK

programme.desc: De siste tre parene må vise at de har den sterkeste forbindelsen for å krones til vinnere. Viser de sitt rette jeg når 50 000 pund står på spill?

programme.desc: The crew of Moya starts blacking out and missing portions of time.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E10 - Relativity
programme.desc: Talyn lands on a planet covered mostly with vegetation that will help him to heal. Crichton, Aeryn and Crais leave the ship in search of Xhalax.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E11 - Incubator
programme.desc: Scorpius puts the neural chip into his own brain in an attempt to retrieve vital wormhole equations from Crichton.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E12 - Meltdown
programme.desc: Talyn gets the urge to fly into a sun. While in its vicinity Stark is contacted by an alien woman who is being held against her will.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E13 - Scratch 'N Sniff
programme.desc: Crichton, D'Argo, Jool and Chiana are forced to take a holiday by Pilot as he is fed up with their constant bickering.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E14 - Infinite Possibilities, Part 1: Daedalus Demands
programme.desc: Crichton must seek out an old friend who has gained too much knowledge about wormholes.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S3 E14 - Infinite Possibilities, Part 1: Daedalus Demands

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E15 - Infinite Possibilities, Part 2: Icarus Abides
programme.desc: Jack (The Ancient) unlocks the wormhole knowledge in Crichton's mind so together they can build a device to destroy the Scarran dreadnought.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S3 E15 - Infinite Possibilities, Part 2: Icarus Abides

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E16 - Revenging Angel
programme.desc: D'Argo injures Crichton, as Crichton lies in a coma/near death, he escapes into a highly animated world. It's Farscape, Chuck Jones/Loony Tunes style.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E17 - The Choice
programme.desc: Aeryn is devastated. She leaves Talyn, and grieves on a planet. Talyn's crew tries to help but she doesn't want their help.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E18 - Fractures
programme.desc: A group of escaped prisoners come aboard Moya followed shortly by Aeryn, Crais and Rygel who have finally returned from Talyn.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E19 - I - Yensch, You - Yensch
programme.desc: D'Argo and Rygel meet Braca and Scorpius in a cafe to conduct negotiations when it is unexpectedly attacked.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S3 E19 - I - Yensch, You - Yensch

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E20 - Into The Lion's Den, Part 1: Lambs To The Slaughter
programme.desc: The crew must stop Scorpius's research on wormhole technology. The only way to stop him is to board the command carrier.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S3 E20 - Into The Lion's Den, Part 1: Lambs To The Slaughter

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E21 - Into The Lion's Den, Part 2: Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
programme.desc: Crais gets Talyn to starburst inside the command carrier, causing it to collapse in on itself.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S3 E21 - Into The Lion's Den, Part 2: Wolf In Sheep's Clothing

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E22 - Dog With Two Bones
programme.desc: Moya takes Talyn's remains to the sacred burial ground where D'Argo is forced to destroy a rogue Leviathan that is attacking other ships.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S3 E22 - Dog With Two Bones

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E1 - Crichton Kicks
programme.desc: Crichton, now aboard a dying leviathan named Elac, encounters an alien named Sikozu who aids him in stopping the Grudeks.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E2 - What Was Lost, Part 1: Sacrifice
programme.desc: Everyone but Aeryn meets on Arnesk, where Jool has discovered the remains of an ancient civilization.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S4 E2 - What Was Lost, Part 1: Sacrifice

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E3 - What Was Lost, Part 2: Resurrection
programme.desc: The crew discovers how far Scorpius has fallen in the Peacekeeper ranks.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S4 E3 - What Was Lost, Part 2: Resurrection

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E4 - Lava's A Many Splendored Thing
programme.desc: The crew is on the way to rendezvous with Moya. After ingesting a concoction of Noranti's they stop for a break on a planet.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S4 E4 - Lava's A Many Splendored Thing

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E5 - Promises
programme.desc: Everyone finally reunites on Moya. But Aeryn returns with Scorpius, who claims to have saved the former Peacekeeper's life.

programme.desc: Tom and Diana continue their investigation on Jordan Collier's plan for mankind. Dennis Ryland returns to NTAC. Isabelle is seriously injured when she takes a classroom hostage.

programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: Andromeda: Att lita på den gordiska labyrinten
programme.desc: En spion från Tri Gemma dyker upp på Andromeda i ett försök att stjäla stjärnkartan.
programme.sub-title: Att lita på den gordiska labyrinten

programme.title: Andromeda: En symmetri av ofullkomlighet
programme.desc: När Rommie blir för känslosam skär fartyget av henne för att kunna utföra diagnostik.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tiden är ute av sinne
programme.desc: Abyss dödar Bekkas vän och besättningen måste ta reda på vilken information de dödade för.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det dissonanta intervallet (del 1)
programme.desc: Andromeda räddar ett skepp som återvänder från fredssamtal med Magog.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det dissonanta intervallet (del 2)
programme.desc: Magog-attacken får allvarliga konsekvenser. Andromeda förstörs, Trance och Dylan antas vara de enda överlevande och Dylan flyr in i vägen tidernas.

programme.title: Andromeda: Vikten (del 1)
programme.desc: Dylan hamnar på Seefra, där den vidskepliga befolkningen inte har någon teknologi.

programme.title: Andromeda: Vikten (del 2)
programme.desc: Beka dumpas på Seefra efter att Andromeda har stulits, och Dylan måste bevisa att skeppet är hans.

programme.title: Andromeda: Phear Phactor Phenom
programme.desc: På Seefra hittar Dylan Harper som har anpassat sig till livet där.

programme.title: Andromeda: Änglarnas förfall
programme.desc: Det visar sig att Doyle är en android som Harper byggt för att innehålla Rommies kärnprogrammering.

programme.title: Andromeda: Eskatologin i vår nutid
programme.desc: Beka vinner ett pris från en radio-DJ, får reda på sanningen om Seefra och hittar Meethusdiagrammet.

programme.title: Andromeda: När det går runt...
programme.desc: En vetenskapsman från det ursprungliga samväldet dyker upp, fångad i en tidsloop.

programme.title: Andromeda: Försök med screed
programme.desc: Flavin återvänder och utlöser ett gängkrig och hjälper Dylan att utvecklas som Paradine.

programme.title: Andromeda: Så bränn de otämnda länderna
programme.desc: En kristall som kan återställa Andromedas kraft upptäcks, men för att få tag på den måste Dylan arbeta för gruvans ägare.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det som kommer att bli var inte
programme.desc: Tunnlar upptäcks på Seefra som kan användas för att nå åtta andra Seefra-planeter.
programme.sub-title: Det som kommer att bli var inte

programme.title: Andromeda: Testet
programme.desc: När en gammal man mördas är Beka, Rhade och Harper huvudmisstänkta och ställs inför rättegång.

programme.title: Andromeda: Genom ett mörkt glas
programme.desc: Rhade leder rebellerna i strid mot en krigsherre på Seefra-5.

programme.title: Andromeda: Stolthet före det fall
programme.desc: Dylan upptäcker att Bekkas pojkvän egentligen var Drago Musevini och att han använde Bekkas DNA för att skapa Nietzscheanerna.

programme.title: Andromeda: Månskenet blir till dig
programme.desc: Beka och Rhade hittar ett prov som antingen kommer att ge dem stora rikedomar eller driva dem till vansinne.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det förflutna är prolix
programme.desc: Harper upptäcker ett program som kan förstöra åtta av Seefras planeter och döda miljontals människor.

programme.title: Andromeda: Attraktionens motsatser
programme.desc: Medan Harper arbetar på ett sätt att rädda Seefra-systemet smyger en spion ombord på Andromeda och attackerar Beka.

programme.title: Andromeda: Att rädda ljuset från en svart sol
programme.desc: Ett försök görs att fixa Seefras blinkande sol, men Trance ersätts av en dubbelgångare.
programme.sub-title: Att rädda ljuset från en svart sol

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Butt Certain
programme.desc: A 6-year-old girl ran and hid when she saw her grandmother being beaten to death, but the man followed, beat and assaulted her. She said the assailant was her uncle, who was later convicted. She recanted her testimony years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Jean Pool
programme.desc: In 1984, the body of college student Laura Salmon was found on a Middle Tennessee farm, covered with her own denim jeans as well as the jeans of the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traffic Violations
programme.desc: The body of a young woman was found a mile from her abandoned car. Police were especially concerned when they realized the victim had come to them for protection just two weeks earlier after a road rage incident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: In 1969, 25-year-old phone operator Diane Maxwell was raped and murdered. Her brother promised he'd find out who was responsible and bring the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Disrobed
programme.desc: The crime scene was especially violent: a husband and wife had been shot to death in their bedroom. Was their 16-year-old daughter complicit?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Driven to Silence
programme.desc: A young hairdresser was sexually assaulted and murdered in her own beauty salon. The evidence at the crime scene didn't match any of the suspects and, after the initial investigation, the case went cold for ten years.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Printed Proof
programme.desc: When two women went missing and were later found brutally murdered, police wondered if they were victims of a hate crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: About Face
programme.desc: A human skeleton was discovered in the North Carolina marshlands. When investigators learned she'd been dead for 18 months, they knew it would be difficult to find out who she was, let alone who killed her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In the Bag
programme.desc: After shooting his victims in the head, the killer staged the scene, placed the incriminating evidence into a plastic bag and tossed it into the river.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Yes, In Deed
programme.desc: It was a tragic twist of fate. Just days after a woman sold her home and moved to a modest trailer, a fire took both the trailer and her life. But the autopsy proved this was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Guarded Secrets
programme.desc: A security guard disappeared from his post without a trace; his remains were found a year later in a remote campsite.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoking Out a Killer
programme.desc: A college senior was found raped and murdered near an unpaved footpath used by students to walk from one side of campus to the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Assets
programme.desc: In 2004, Mary Ann Clibbery was found brutally murdered at her Illinois business. Investigators had to determine if this was a robbery gone wrong or a calculated murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Hunting
programme.desc: In 2006, Texas real estate agent Sarah Anne Walker was found brutally murdered in a model home. Weeks later, a witness came forward who may have seen the killer. Police used forensic hypnosis to help him recall every detail of the man's appearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoot to Thrill
programme.desc: In 2003, St. Cloud teenager Jason MacLennan returned home after a night out with friends and discovered his father's body lying in a pool of blood.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Political Thriller
programme.desc: In 2006, Nevada politician Kathy Augustine died mysteriously during a re-election campaign. The medical examiner could neither isolate the cause of death, nor explain the tiny puncture wounds discovered during the autopsy.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Cross
programme.desc: In 1996, Virginia Beach police arrive at the Makdessi apartment to find the bloodied bodies of Elise Makdessi and Navy sailor Quincy Brown. But was Brown Elise's lover or her assailant?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dancing with the Devil
programme.desc: In 1999, Patrick McRae was found dead in his Des Moines home and the crime scene was awash with blood. Analysis showed it had come from two people, one of whom was female.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Dance
programme.desc: In 2000, the body of exotic dancer Rachel Siani was found beneath a New Jersey bridge. Investigators wondered if she had committed suicide. They discovered that Rachel offered to assist a drunk customer named John "Jack" Denofa to his motel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Constructive Criticism
programme.desc: In 2000, construction manager Darrell North was found dead in his work trailer in Ft. Worth, Texas. When investigators arrived, they found that he had been stabbed 46 times, indicating a personal relationship between the victim and the attacker.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Window Watcher
programme.desc: In 1986, Gary Dale Larson was stabbed to death in his Edmond, Oklahoma home. The killer then sexually assaulted Larson's girlfriend, Janet Haynes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stranger in the Night
programme.desc: In 1991, Dorothy Donovan was murdered in her Dover, Delaware home. When her son stated that she was murdered by a hitchhiker he had picked up, police were skeptical.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kidnapping
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Calculated Coincidence
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold — until police discover a link between their prime suspect and an unsolved murder committed six years earlier in a different state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unmasked
programme.desc: A serial rapist is on the loose in a Texas town. No one knew where he'd strike next, but the audacity of his attacks and the escalation of violence against his victims made finding him imperative.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim had been stabbed more than thirty times and the crime scene was awash with her blood. Near her head, police discovered a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Dis-service
programme.desc: A young woman attends evening church services, then disappears. When her abandoned car is found, the tank is empty and a gas can she kept in her trunk for emergencies is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seedy Intentions
programme.desc: When a 9-year-old girl goes missing, police and volunteers spend weeks searching for her. A psychic's vision leads to a field where her body is discovered, along with what investigators hope is enough evidence to find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: DNA Dragnet
programme.desc: Digital enhancement of security camera footage shows that what appears to be a casual encounter is actually a forced abduction. When investigators suspect the crimes are not random, they fear a serial killer may be on the loose.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: Forensic Files: As Fault
programme.desc: Witnesses saw a woman in the back of a truck, flailing her arms and screaming. When they found a jacket near a pool of blood, they knew what they had seen wasn't a joy ride.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Ties
programme.desc: When court clerk Peter Porco doesn't report to work in November 2004, a courts officer is ordered to the Porcos' family home in Bethlehem, NY.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trouble Brewing
programme.desc: Two suspects are linked to a murder by bloodstained boots and a gun, but the owner of the items says he has never met the victim. Investigators hope manufacturing codes from beer bottles will determine who is telling the truth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Holy Terror
programme.desc: This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.

programme.desc: There was no clear reason for a young, healthy college student to be dead. But when the coroner discovered a tiny clue during the autopsy, investigators were able to uncover a mystery filled with betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
programme.sub-title: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Patterns Of Guilt
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Youths
programme.desc: A young girl playing in her yard in Spokane, Washington suddenly vanishes. In St. Louis, another girl leaves to visit a friend. She never arrived.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Partners In Crime
programme.desc: They say that a burden shared is a burden halved, but when partners team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy. Investigators must rely on forensic science to capture partners in crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shreds of Evidence
programme.desc: Hairs and Fibers: The tiniest filament can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways. Investigators have come to rely on forensic evidence as fine as a carpet fiber or as innocent as an eyelash to crack difficult cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Discoveries
programme.desc: Some cases simply can't be solved with current technology or with the evidence at hand. But that doesn't mean they'll remain unsolved forever.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Infallible Witness
programme.desc: Investigators are always on the cutting edge of new forensic techniques that can help them solve cases more accurately. An experimental "brain fingerprinting" technique has already won the acquittal of a police officer accused of a drug charge.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Women Who Kill
programme.desc: Men don't have a monopoly on murder, but it's still extraordinary when women kill. Though female killers are as deadly as males, they choose less violent methods.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Mind Hunters
programme.desc: Psychological Profiling: Journey into the dark recesses and calculated madness present only in our worst nightmares, and in the minds of serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Living In Terror
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.desc: Bambi gives us a rare, honest look into her ultra-exclusive lifestyle in LA. Tiffany confronts C.T. over a rotten business deal.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Holiday Hell With My Feuding Family
programme.desc: There’s no worse time to be fighting with your family than during the holidays. Our old friends Donna and her cheating husband Richard join us for a holiday feast!
programme.sub-title: Holiday Hell With My Feuding Family

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Cheating Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Chris and Steve confess to cheating on their girlfriends and Michelle wants to tell her boyfriend she has a mistress. The tension is high on today's Jerry Springer Show!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: My Pimp Runs My Family
programme.desc: Tracy and Allen have been living in a car. Her two older sisters are here to convince her to temporarily live with them and go back to school until he can provide for them.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I'm Marrying a Transsexual!
programme.desc: Jerry is 58 years old and has had three big changes. He is currently happily engaged to a woman named Joy and speaks about his past gender confusion.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I Have Many Lovers
programme.desc: Today, Rufus comes clean about cheating on Treynae with Cheeta and Rhonda tells her girlfriend Lovette that she's in an affair with another woman! Who will choose whom?

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Wife Discovers Husband's Secret Family
programme.desc: Ron left Stacie when she was 8 months pregnant with his child for Audrey and thought he'd found his soul mate. Are Stacie's kids all his? Watch this classic showdown today!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Jerry Rescues An Obese Man
programme.desc: Denny weighs over 800 pounds and has been unable to leave his bed for the past 5 weeks and is ready to change his life. Today we follow Denny's courageous journey.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Woman In Labor Confronts Mistress
programme.desc: The first time Nancy, Tara and Versell appeared on the show, Nancy was pregnant with Versell's baby. He was cheating on her with Tara and now she's pregnant! Who will go?

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Dear Santa
programme.desc: Jerry is joined by Santa and his elves to answer 7 very special Christmas letters from needy children. Watch these happy faces light up when their holiday wishes are granted!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: You Won't Marry Your Gay Lover!
programme.desc: Friends and family refuse to accept same sex marriage! Martin won’t let his son marry his boyfriend. April wants her ex back, but he’s in love with a man! Who has the final say?
programme.sub-title: You Won't Marry Your Gay Lover!

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Best Friends Kissing
programme.desc: Brody och Audrina utforskar nya romanser medan Brandon är redo att fördjupa sitt förhållande. Heidi och Spencer kämpar med frågan om de ska ha fler barn och behöver avreagera sig. Jason och Ashley får livsomvälvande nyheter.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: The Last Hurrah
programme.desc: Gruppens semester tar en ny vändning när Kaitlynn oväntat står ansikte mot ansikte med Brodys nya flamma. Brandons hopp om en romantisk resa med Dani riskerar att gå om intet, medan en osannolik kontakt börjar blomstra.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Who's a Better Kisser
programme.desc: Brodys och Heidis vänskap står vid ett vägskäl efter att en middag spårat ur. Medan Brody undrar om Amber är rätt för honom blir frågorna bara fler för Audrina efter första kyssen med Sean. Justin öppnar sig för gruppen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You Told Her?!
programme.desc: Heidi och Spencer får en chock när deras beteende har blivit ett samtalsämne. Audrina står vid ett vägskäl med Brody och Sean. Caroline gör ett djärvt ställningstagande angående Kaitlynn.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I'm Back in LA Bitches!
programme.desc: Gänget firar Kristin Cavallaris besök i L.A. Det blir spänt mellan Heidi och Audrina, men Justin och Jason stärker sin vänskap. En bra kväll går över till en bra morgon när Brody och Audrina sätter sin personkemi på prov.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: "Who Slept at Your House?"
programme.desc: Kristin grillar Brody om övernattningen med Audrina. Rykten börjar gå under en resa till Lake Tahoe, och Kaitlynn känner sig utanför. Caroline konfronterar Kaitlynn om deras kyliga relation, och Jason hör att Spencer ifrågasätter hans nykterhet.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Get Dessert and Bail
programme.desc: Brodys and Audrinas flirt blir intensivare. Kriget mellan Pratts and Wahlers når kokpunkten, medan Brandon inte vet hur han ska tolka Danis kyliga respons när han föreslår att de ska flytt aihop. Audrinas och Heidis vänksap når ett vägskäl.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Time Heals Not Some Things
programme.desc: Heidi och Spencer söker hjälp för att få hjälp med sin ekonomi. Medan Kaitlynns nya förhållande fortsätter att blomstra hotar en flirt från Brandons förflutna att förvärra situationen med Dani. Justin återupptar kontakten med sin pappa.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: That's Math Right There
programme.desc: Kaitlynns beslut att flytta ihop med sin kille får alla att undra vad det är som händer. Heidi & Spencer oroar sig för sitt företag, medan Brandon omvärderar sitt förhållande och Audrina inser saker om Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: What About Me?
programme.desc: På Speidis hälsoretreat ryktas det om att Kaitlynn är gravid. Brandon har chockerande nyheter om sitt förhållande. Paret Wahler har svårt att hålla sams med paret Pratt, som är distraherade av möjliga kommande förändringar i deras liv.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Timing Is Everything
programme.desc: Kaitlynn berättar för Brody att hon är gravid men oroar sig för mötet mellan honom och Kris på retreatet. Pratts & Wahlers tar äntligen itu med grälet som har splittrat gruppen och Justin inser vikten av att hålla kontakten.

programme.title: The Hills: New City, New Drama
programme.desc: Lauren Conrad försöker balansera modeskola, en praktikantplats och en rumskamrat som saboterar hennes event för jobbet och inser snabbt att allt är större i Los Angeles - även hennes problem.

programme.title: The Hills: A Change of Plans
programme.desc: Heidi lyckas få en intervju för sitt drömjobb, vilket får henne att fundera på att hoppa av skolan för gott och får Lauren att inse att hon och Heidi kan vara inne på helt olika banor.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Call
programme.desc: Teen Vogue skickar Lauren på ett ärende över natten som tar henne till New York City, men när hon återvänder till LA finner hon en överraskning från det förflutna. Heidi inser att livet inte är en fest bara för att man arrangerar fester.

programme.title: The Hills: Lauren and Jason: Part 2
programme.desc: När Jason, Laurens ex från Laguna Beach, dyker upp i hennes liv igen inser Lauren att hon kanske inte har kommit över honom lika mycket som hon trodde. Samtidigt börjar Heidi undra om hennes nya jobb verkligen är värt det.

programme.title: The Hills: Jason's Birthday
programme.desc: Lauren skyndar sig hem från ett Teen Vogue-event för att tillbringa Jasons födelsedag med honom, men kvällen går inte riktigt som väntat. Audrina söker råd från Heidi om hennes senaste dejt med modellen och skådisen Danny.

programme.title: The Hills: Boyfriends and Work Don't Mix
programme.desc: Jason distraherar Lauren mer och mer från både jobbet och skolan. Heidi får äntligen sin stora chans att jobba på nattklubb, men det kunde inte ha kommit olägligare.

programme.title: The Hills: Somebody Always Has to Cry
programme.desc: Det är gängets första stora helgdag i LA, och inte alla får vad de har önskat sig. Lauren har svårt att få sig en nyårskyss när Jason får veta att hon oväntat fått kontakt med ett gammalt ex.

programme.title: The Hills: You Can't Just Be With Me?
programme.desc: Jason vill göra Laurens 20-årsdag speciell, men när hon ljuger om att jobba med manliga modeller för Teen Vogue utsätts deras förhållande för en stor prövning.
programme.sub-title: You Can't Just Be With Me?

programme.title: The Hills: Love is Not a Maybe Thing
programme.desc: Heidi har äntligen fått nog av all dramatik med Jordan. Lauren och Jason funderar på att ta nästa steg i deras förhållande.
programme.sub-title: Love is Not a Maybe Thing

programme.title: The Hills: Timing is Everything
programme.desc: När Laurens slit med LA Fashion Week kan leda till ett stort steg i karrirären har hon svårt att välja mellan hennes jobb och hennes pojkvän.

programme.title: The Hills: Out With The Old
programme.desc: Sommaren med pojkvännen Jason gick inte så bra, så Lauren bestämmer sig för att göra slut och återvända till Teen Vogue för att möta sin chef, som inte är glad. Heidi har problem med killen som både hon och Audrina dejtar.

programme.title: The Hills: When You Least Expect It
programme.desc: Lauren går på sin första dejt sen det tog slut med Jason och får en stor utmaning på jobbet när hon får uppgiften att jobba med en modevisning. Heidi har en chockerande hemlighet som hon måste berätta för sin pojkvän.

programme.title: The Hills: The Best Night Ever
programme.desc: När Audrina objuden dyker upp på Heidis födelsedag blir hon snart varse om att Heidi inte är redo att förlåta henne. Lauren, fast besluten att koncentrera sig på jobbet, faller för en charmig ny kille i hennes liv - Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Who Do You Trust?
programme.desc: Audrina berättar för Heidi om Spencers vänsterprassel, men Heidi tror inte på henne - förrän hon ser det med egna ögon. Lauren är fortfarande inte säker på om hon är redo för ett nytt förhållande.

programme.title: The Hills: One Big Interruption
programme.desc: Heidi tar en paus från Spencer men saknar honom mer än hon hade trott. Lauren ska planera en Teen Vogue-middag, men superpraktikanten Emily från New York tar över.

programme.title: The Hills: You Have Chosen
programme.desc: När Lauren berättar för Heidi vad hon egentligen tycker om Spencer måste Heidi välja mellan sin bästa vän och sin pojkvän.

programme.title: The Hills: With Friends Like These...
programme.desc: Lauren inser att hon inte kan lita på sin bästa vän när Heidi sammanför Jen och Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Enough Is Enough
programme.desc: Spencer ber Heidi att flytta in hos honom, men Heidi vet inte vad hon ska göra eller hur hon ska berätta det för sin rumskompis Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: New Year, New Friends
programme.desc: Laurens 21-årsdag är full av överraskningar när Heidi och Audrina håller en överraskningsfest för henne. Jen försöker sluta fred med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Apology Not Accepted
programme.desc: Lauren fyller 21 och Heidi har stora planer för födelsedagskalaset. Men innan festen bestämmer hon sig för att berätta för Lauren att Spencer vill att de ska flytta ihop.

programme.title: The Hills: Goodbye for Now
programme.desc: I säsongsfinalen blir det spänt när Heidi måste besluta om hon ska flytta ihop med Spencer eller inte. Lauren vänder sig till Audrina när hon vill fylla tomrummet efter sin bästa vän, och Whitney flyger till New York för en intervju.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Daisy's Disaster
programme.desc: Kommer ett nytillskott att innebära lycka för Josiah? Daisy drabbas dubbelt när hennes ex Mattys känslor för Natalee gör att hennes vänskap med tjejerna förstörs.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Bobby's Revenge
programme.desc: En ny ankomst innebär problem för George, och Bobby kan hämnas. Natalee vill ha grönt ljus från Daisy att satsa på Matty, och Aaron kanske leker med elden.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Messages From Home
programme.desc: Daisy hoppas att nykomlingen är hennes drömprins. Bobby börjar bry sig mer om Rhianne igen och lite extra kraft får huset att kännas som hemma.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Bayley's Home Truths
programme.desc: Alex får chansen att blir romantisk med nya galna Dominika. Natalee och Matty kommer varandra närmare och en ny chockerande ankomst kan innebära slutet för George och Bayley.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach
programme.desc: Dags för avslutningsfest. Kan originaltjejerna åka hem som vänner? Överlever några av paren? Eller kommer en sista ankomst att göra att allt vänds upp och ner i huset?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Love, Next Love
programme.desc: Tio realitykändisar åker till paradiset för att hitta kärleken, men vet att deras ex kommer att förstöra festen. Kommer exen att förstöra allt, eller kan man försonas?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Serving Revenge
programme.desc: En överraskning i Hemlighålet blir en ögonöppnare för Mark och Elena. Ett nytt ex kommer men vet inte om syftet är kärlek eller hämnd, och ett annat ex får åka hem.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: I Put a Crush on You
programme.desc: En telefonlek slutar med en uppgörelse mellan Aubrey och Devin. En färgfest utartar. Det blir dags för första Dyrkdejten.
programme.sub-title: I Put a Crush on You

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Cam You Feel the Love Tonight
programme.desc: Cameron slits mellan sitt ex och en av de nya. Ett par måste bestämma om de är ett par eller ej. Ett ex skickas hem.
programme.sub-title: Cam You Feel the Love Tonight

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: This is Episode 5 But Let's Call It 6
programme.desc: Devin får ta emot Maries vrede när han kallar henne en sexa. Billy lägger in en stöt på Lexi. Ett nytt ex blir spännande för en av singlarna. En dyrkdejt delas ut.
programme.sub-title: This is Episode 5 But Let's Call It 6

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: The Mother of All Secrets
programme.desc: En spirande romans förstörs av ett nytt ex och ett besök från mamma. Marie försöker smälta sexan. Singlarna samarbetar för att skicka hem ett ex som sätter käppar i hjulen för en vän.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Exes Haunt These Fields
programme.desc: Ett ex kommer vid värsta tänkbara tidpunkt och förstör en spirande romans mellan en singel och ett annat ex. Det hettar till mellan Mark och Aubrey. Billy har känslor för Lexi. En dyrkdejt delas ut.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Coffey Run
programme.desc: Cameron får står till svars för brott mot sina ex. Mark och Aubrey får ta itu med ett oväntat ex. Ett ex får åka hem.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: I Want It That Way
programme.desc: Aubrey vill både äta kakan och ha den kvar när det gäller Mark och Coffey. Cameron kan inte låta Ariana gå vidare. Cirkusen är i stan och en dyrkdejt delas ut.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Roses Are Red, Exes Make You Blue
programme.desc: Mechies spirande kärlek prövas när ett nytt ex anländer. Vid en överraskande ceremoni blir singlarna varse att deras agerande får konsekvenser. Ett hemligt förhållande blir avslöjat.
programme.sub-title: Roses Are Red, Exes Make You Blue

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Thruple Trouble
programme.desc: Aubreys och Marks förhållande slår i botten. Devins nya romans gör att Marie flippar ur. Sista crushdejten utses och en oväntad gäst avbryter

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Two for One Deal
programme.desc: Coffey befinner sig mitt i Marks och Aubreys uppbrott. Mechie slits mellan sitt ex och sin nya kärlek vilket får Ariana att sitta på helspänn. Två ex skickas hem i dissceremonin.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Show Me the Receipts
programme.desc: En del bekanta och obekanta ansikten dyker upp för att röra om i grytan. Ett lögndetektortest tvingar vissa singlar att erkänna att de är struliga.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: The Final Crush
programme.desc: Huset måste brottas med resultatet från lögndetektortesterna. Singlarna måste fatta det ultimata beslutet. Kommer de att åka hem med exet, en ny kärlek eller ensamma?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion
programme.desc: Singlarna och exen återförenas för första gången sen den sista dyrkceremonin. Programledare är Jared Haibon och vi får veta vilka par som fortfarande är i smekmånadsstadiet, vilka som gjort slut och vilka som nu delar säng med sina ex.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Celeb Surprises
programme.desc: Åtta heta kärlekstörstande kändisar träffas i en villa. Kori ser ett bekant ansikte medan Mike tar sin kändisflört på dejt. Men det kommer fler överraskningar innan det första exet rör upp känslorna!

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1988 Daihatsu HiJet
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet från West Coast Customs Wyatts Daihatsu Hi-Jet. Temat är "jet" och de monterar t.o.m. äkta "fasten your seat belt"-skyltar från ett flygplan på bilen.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1978 Cadillac Sedan DeVille
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar gänget Niles Cadillac Sedan DeVille. Nile rullar hem i en pärlemorlackad ceriserosa bil med bagageluckan full av nya skor.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1986 Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet Logans Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme. Logan rullar hem med basketgolv och lack i två färger.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1992 Honda Civic
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet Christines Honda Civic. Tre dagar efter att avsnittet med Christine sändes dog en nära släkting i magcancer.
